senses.exampleEnglish: The course places emphasis on practical communication rather than asking students to memorize long lists of grammatical terms.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程强调实际交流，而不是要求学生背诵很长的语法术语表。

senses.english: a particular version of something that is sold to the public
senses.exampleEnglish: The latest edition includes updated maps, which should help travellers avoid roads that are no longer open.
senses.exampleChinese: 最新版包含更新后的地图，应该能帮助旅行者避开已经关闭的道路。

senses.english: expensive, near white color metal (symbol Ag)
senses.exampleEnglish: The ring was made of silver rather than gold, which suited her preference for simple, pale jewellery.
senses.exampleChinese: 这枚戒指由银而非金制成，符合她对简洁、浅色首饰的偏好。

senses.english: made of silver or having a pale shiny grey colour
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a silver frame because it matched the lamp without drawing attention away from the photograph.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选择银色相框，因为它与灯相配，又不抢照片的焦点。

senses.english: activities that make people have a good time by singing, telling jokes, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel provides evening entertainment, although guests who prefer a quiet night can use the upstairs lounge.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店提供晚间娱乐活动，不过喜欢安静夜晚的客人可以使用楼上的休息室。

senses.english: good; always telling the truth and not stealing
senses.exampleEnglish: Please give me an honest answer, even if you think I might be disappointed by your opinion.
senses.exampleChinese: 请给我一个诚实的回答，即使你认为你的看法可能会让我失望。

senses.english: real and sincere rather than pretended
senses.exampleEnglish: His honest enthusiasm helped the new volunteers feel welcome even when the first training session became confusing.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使第一次培训令人困惑，他真诚的热情仍让新志愿者感到受欢迎。

senses.english: to begin or attempt, commit oneself to and begin
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity agreed to undertake the repairs once enough volunteers with the necessary experience had offered their help.
senses.exampleChinese: 足够多具备所需经验的志愿者表示愿意帮忙后，这家慈善机构同意着手修缮。

senses.english: to promise that you will do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The company will undertake to complete the repairs before winter, provided the council gives permission to close the road temporarily.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要议会允许临时封路，公司就承诺冬前完成维修。

senses.english: concerning the business of selling products to the public for personal use
senses.exampleEnglish: She gained retail experience in a local bookshop before applying for a job managing a larger store.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先在当地书店积累零售经验，再申请管理一家更大商店的工作。

senses.english: the business of selling goods directly to the public
senses.exampleEnglish: She returned to retail after several years in an office because she missed talking to customers every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 在办公室工作几年后，她重返零售业，因为想念每天与顾客交谈。

senses.english: to sell to the public, or be sold for a particular price
senses.exampleEnglish: The books retail for less online, although the local shop includes delivery and gives advice about suitable titles.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些书网上零售价更低，不过本地书店包送货，还会推荐合适书目。

senses.english: thin, flexible thread of metal
senses.exampleEnglish: We used a piece of wire to support the young plant until its stem grew strong enough.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用一段金属丝支撑这棵幼苗，直到它的茎长得足够结实。

senses.english: to connect electrical equipment or provide electrical wiring
senses.exampleEnglish: A qualified technician will wire the new room before the builders close the walls and install the shelves.
senses.exampleChinese: 合格技术员会先给新房间布线，再由建筑工封墙并安装架子。

senses.english: to send money electronically from one account or place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The customer asked whether she could wire the payment before the supplier arranged delivery of the ordered equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 供应商安排订购设备配送前，顾客询问能否电汇付款。

phrases.english: continuing until the very last moment before an outcome or deadline
phrases.exampleEnglish: The preparations went down to the wire because the final delivery arrived only minutes before the doors opened.
phrases.exampleChinese: 准备拖到最后关头，因为最后一批货开门前几分钟才到。

phrases.english: a very energetic and lively person, used informally
phrases.exampleEnglish: The new volunteer is a live wire who keeps suggesting activities whenever the group has a quiet moment.
phrases.exampleChinese: 新志愿者活力十足，大家一有空就不断提活动建议。

senses.english: not being likely to happen or not likely to be the truth
senses.exampleEnglish: It seems unlikely that the outdoor concert will continue if the forecast of heavy rain proves correct.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果大雨预报准确，室外音乐会似乎不太可能继续进行。

senses.english: sexually or romantically attracted to people of the same sex, especially men
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel follows a gay teenager who gradually becomes more confident after finding friends who accept him without judgement.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说讲述一名同性恋少年找到接纳自己的朋友后逐渐变得自信。

senses.english: process of producing a book or magazine
senses.exampleEnglish: The author checked every reference carefully before publication because several readers might want to consult the original sources.
senses.exampleChinese: 出版前，作者仔细核对每条参考资料，因为一些读者可能想查阅原始来源。

senses.english: a book, magazine, newspaper, or other published work
senses.exampleEnglish: The library keeps a local publication that records village events rarely mentioned in the larger regional newspapers.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆保存一种地方刊物，记录大地区报纸很少提及的村庄事件。

senses.english: very small in degree or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a slight delay at the entrance while staff checked whether everyone had the correct ticket.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作人员核查每个人的票是否正确时，入口处出现了短暂延误。

senses.english: a small act of disrespect or an insult
senses.exampleEnglish: She did not intend the remark as a slight, but her colleague misunderstood it and became unusually quiet.
senses.exampleChinese: 她无意用那句话冒犯，但同事误解了，变得异常沉默。

senses.english: to treat someone as unimportant
senses.exampleEnglish: They did not mean to slight the new member, who had simply been left out of an outdated mailing list.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们并非有意怠慢新成员，只是过时的邮件名单漏掉了他。

senses.english: not familiar or famous
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist was still unknown when a small local gallery offered to display her photographs for the first time.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地一家小画廊首次提出展出她的照片时，这位艺术家还不为人知。

senses.english: a person or thing that is not known or understood
senses.exampleEnglish: The biggest unknown was the weather, which could change the number of visitors who arrived at the outdoor event.
senses.exampleChinese: 最大的未知因素是天气，它可能改变参加户外活动的人数。

senses.english: basic structure of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement provides a framework for cooperation while leaving individual schools free to develop their own activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议为合作提供了框架，同时让各学校自由开展自己的活动。

senses.english: a structure that supports or gives shape to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden framework remained strong even though the building's outer walls needed repairs after years of rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 木框架依然坚固，尽管建筑外墙多年受雨水影响需要修缮。

senses.english: area of space used for a particular reason
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors must leave their cars outside the pedestrian zone so that families can explore the old town safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客必须把车停在步行区外，让家庭游客能安全游览老城区。

senses.english: to prevent from doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum may restrict access to certain rooms while workers repair the damaged ceiling above the main staircase.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人修理主楼梯上方受损天花板时，博物馆可能限制进入某些房间。

senses.english: to find, describe or discover by investigation
senses.exampleEnglish: By checking old photographs, we managed to trace the path that the river followed before the town expanded.
senses.exampleChinese: 通过查看老照片，我们成功追溯了城镇扩张前河流所经过的路线。

senses.english: a sign showing that something existed or happened
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a trace of the old path beneath the grass, although most of it had disappeared.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在草下发现旧路的一点痕迹，尽管大部分已经消失。

senses.english: a very small amount of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The test found a trace of salt in the water, so the class compared it with another sample.
senses.exampleChinese: 检测在水中发现微量盐，因此全班拿它与另一份样本比较。

phrases.english: leaving no sign showing where someone or something has gone
phrases.exampleEnglish: The missing folder seemed to vanish without a trace until someone remembered moving it to a different cupboard.
phrases.exampleChinese: 丢失文件夹仿佛无影无踪，直到有人想起移到了另一柜子。

senses.english: a measure of length; 1/12 of a foot (2.54 centimeters)
senses.exampleEnglish: Move the shelf an inch to the left so that the cupboard door can open without catching it.
senses.exampleChinese: 把架子向左移动一英寸，让柜门打开时不会碰到它。

senses.english: to move very slowly or by small amounts
senses.exampleEnglish: The bus began to inch forward once the delivery truck had moved far enough to clear the narrow road.
senses.exampleChinese: 货车移动到足以让开狭路后，公交车开始缓缓前进。

senses.english: being about equal in value, use, or meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: The two qualifications are broadly equivalent, although employers may prefer one depending on the role you apply for.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两项资格大致相当，但雇主可能根据你申请的职位偏好其中一种。

senses.english: a thing equal in value, purpose, or meaning to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked for a Chinese equivalent that expressed the same idea without translating every English word separately.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师要求给出表达相同概念的中文对应说法，而不是逐个翻译英文词。

senses.english: firm and strongly built rather than weak or unstable
senses.exampleEnglish: The table needs a solid base because it will hold several heavy pieces of equipment during the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 桌子需要结实的底座，因为演示期间会放置几件沉重的设备。

senses.english: having a fixed shape rather than being a liquid or gas
senses.exampleEnglish: The students compared solid wax with melted wax to understand how heating can change a material's form.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生比较固态蜡与熔化的蜡，理解加热如何改变材料形态。

senses.english: strong and dependable, or based on good evidence or knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal needs solid evidence because the committee must explain why public money should support the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案需要充分证据，因为委员会必须解释为什么应以公共资金支持项目。

senses.english: a substance with a fixed shape
senses.exampleEnglish: The demonstration showed how a solid can become a liquid when enough heat is added to it.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示展示了向固体加入足够热量后，它如何变成液体。

senses.english: a business or organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The social enterprise uses its profits to provide affordable meals for people living in the surrounding neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家社会企业用利润为周边社区的居民提供价格实惠的饭菜。

senses.english: the willingness and ability to organise difficult new activities
senses.exampleEnglish: Her enterprise impressed the neighbours, who had assumed that turning the empty shop into a café was impossible.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的进取心让邻居佩服，他们原以为不可能把空商店变成咖啡馆。

senses.english: a polite word for 'old', used to describe people
senses.exampleEnglish: The new bus service helps elderly residents reach the shops without having to walk up the steep hill.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的公交服务帮助老年居民去商店，不必再步行爬上陡坡。

senses.english: to need to pay money to a person, bank, business, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: I still owe my sister some money because she paid for both tickets when I forgot my wallet.
senses.exampleChinese: 我还欠姐姐一些钱，因为我忘带钱包时，她支付了两张票的费用。

senses.english: to have something because of someone's help or a particular cause
senses.exampleEnglish: We owe much of our progress to volunteers who patiently tested the instructions before the event opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们很大部分进展应归功于活动开始前耐心测试说明的志愿者。

senses.english: person who leads a state or province
senses.exampleEnglish: The governor visited the damaged town and spoke with residents about which public services needed attention first.
senses.exampleChinese: 州长访问了受灾城镇，并与居民讨论哪些公共服务最需要优先处理。

senses.english: a set of clothes that show you are part of a group or school
senses.exampleEnglish: Students can wear a light jacket over their uniform when the classrooms become cold during winter mornings.
senses.exampleChinese: 冬天早晨教室变冷时，学生可以在校服外面穿一件薄夹克。

senses.english: the same in all parts or for all members
senses.exampleEnglish: The team used a uniform format so that readers could compare results from different schools without extra explanation.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队采用统一格式，让读者不必额外解释就能比较不同学校的结果。

senses.english: a town or an area of a town next to water where ships arrive and leave from
senses.exampleEnglish: The ship remained in the port until the strong winds had passed and conditions were safe again.
senses.exampleChinese: 船一直停在港口，直到强风过去、条件重新变得安全。

senses.english: a connection point on a computer or other electronic device
senses.exampleEnglish: The camera connects to a USB port, allowing us to transfer the photographs before the next lesson begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 相机连接到USB接口，让我们能在下节课前传完照片。

senses.english: a strong sweet wine originally from Portugal
senses.exampleEnglish: The menu offered a glass of port with dessert, although several guests chose coffee or an alcohol-free drink instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 菜单提供餐后甜点配波特酒，不过几位客人改选咖啡或无酒精饮料。

senses.english: how high or low a sound is
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to notice how the pitch changed when the singer moved to a higher note.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们注意歌手唱到更高音符时，音高如何变化。

senses.english: a marked outdoor area used for sports such as football
senses.exampleEnglish: The football pitch was too wet for the match, so the teams agreed to play the following weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 足球场太湿无法比赛，因此两队约好下个周末再赛。

senses.english: a short persuasive talk intended to sell an idea or product
senses.exampleEnglish: Her pitch explained how the service would save time rather than listing every technical feature it offered.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的推销陈述说明服务如何省时，而不是列出全部技术功能。

senses.english: to throw a ball towards a player who tries to hit it
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach showed us how to pitch the ball before letting everyone practise with a softer training version.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练先示范怎样投球，再让大家用较软的训练球练习。

senses.english: to present an idea persuasively to try to gain support
senses.exampleEnglish: They will pitch their idea to the school committee after testing whether students actually want the proposed service.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们会先测试学生是否真的需要这项服务，再向学校委员会推介想法。

senses.english: a dark sticky substance used to make surfaces or joints waterproof
senses.exampleEnglish: The display explained how builders once used pitch to protect wooden boats from water entering through small gaps.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释了旧时造船者如何用沥青阻止水从小缝进入木船。

senses.english: to put up a tent so that it can be used
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to pitch the tent before sunset because the campsite has no lighting beyond the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们得日落前搭好帐篷，因为营地正门外没有照明。

phrases.english: to join others in doing a task
phrases.exampleEnglish: If everyone can pitch in for half an hour, we should finish clearing the hall before the next group arrives.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若大家帮半小时，就能赶在下组到来前清完大厅。

senses.english: when someone or something gets to a place
senses.exampleEnglish: We prepared a simple meal before their arrival so that everyone could relax after the long journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们到来前，我们准备了一顿简餐，让大家长途旅行后都能放松。

senses.english: being of the time being discussed
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition places the painter's work beside contemporary photographs to show how people dressed during that period.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览把画家的作品与同时代照片并列，展示当时人们的穿着。

senses.english: belonging to the present period
senses.exampleEnglish: The gallery combines contemporary art with older works so that visitors can compare different approaches to familiar subjects.
senses.exampleChinese: 画廊把当代艺术与旧作品结合，让游客比较对熟悉主题的不同处理方式。

senses.english: a person who lives at the same time as someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: Unlike many of her contemporaries, the writer described ordinary working families rather than concentrating on wealthy society.
senses.exampleChinese: 与许多同时代人不同，这位作家描写普通工薪家庭，而不是聚焦富裕阶层。

senses.english: place in a fence which can be opened or closed
senses.exampleEnglish: Please close the garden gate behind you because the dog may run towards the road if it escapes.
senses.exampleChinese: 请随手关好花园门，因为狗跑出去后可能会冲向公路。

senses.english: state of being comfortable or relaxed
senses.exampleEnglish: Her friendly introduction put the visitors at ease before they began discussing the questions that concerned them.
senses.exampleChinese: 她友好的开场白让来访者放松下来，然后他们开始讨论关心的问题。

senses.english: to make something less serious, painful, or difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: An extra bus should ease pressure on the morning service, which has become crowded since the new school opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 新学校开办后早班车拥挤，加开一班应能缓解压力。

senses.english: to move or make something move slowly and carefully
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to ease the large cupboard through the doorway without damaging the recently painted wooden frame.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们必须小心把大柜子挪过门口，不损伤新漆的木门框。

senses.english: the quality of doing something without difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: The ease with which children used the model surprised the designers, who had expected to give much longer instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子用模型很轻松，设计者很惊讶，原以为要更长说明。

phrases.english: comfortable and not worried
phrases.exampleEnglish: The friendly welcome helped everyone feel at ease before they were asked to explain why they had joined the course.
phrases.exampleChinese: 友好的欢迎让大家放松，再请他们说明为何参加课程。

phrases.english: to become less intense or reduce effort or pressure
phrases.exampleEnglish: We waited for the rain to ease off before leaving the shelter and following the path back towards the village.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们等雨减弱，再离开遮蔽处沿路回村。

senses.english: alcoholic drink that is made from wheat or grains
senses.exampleEnglish: The restaurant serves local beer, but it also offers several alcohol-free drinks for guests who prefer them.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家餐馆供应本地啤酒，也为有需要的客人提供几种无酒精饮料。

senses.english: person who works in one specific area of a field or profession
senses.exampleEnglish: The school invited a reading specialist to suggest activities for pupils who needed more support with longer texts.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校邀请阅读专家，为阅读长篇文章需要更多支持的学生推荐活动。

senses.english: relating to a particular subject or requiring special knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: The repair requires specialist tools, so we asked a local workshop rather than attempting it without experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 维修需要专门工具，因此我们找了当地工坊，没有毫无经验就尝试。

senses.english: to make sure that something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser called to assure us that our seats would be reserved despite the delay to our train.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者打电话向我们保证，尽管火车延误，我们的座位仍会保留。

senses.english: description listing the basic information about a person or group
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the speaker's profile before the event so that you can prepare questions relevant to her research.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动前先阅读演讲者的简介，这样就能准备与她的研究相关的问题。

senses.english: the shape of a face or object seen from the side
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist drew her profile against a plain background so that the shape of her face stood out clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家以素色背景画她的侧面，让脸部轮廓清晰突出。

senses.english: the amount of attention a person or organisation receives
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition raised the village's profile, attracting visitors who had previously travelled straight through on their way to the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览提高了村庄知名度，吸引了以往前往海岸时只是路过的游客。

senses.english: to give a detailed description of a person or organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The magazine will profile local volunteers who have helped transform unused buildings into spaces for the whole community.
senses.exampleChinese: 杂志将介绍帮助把闲置建筑改造成社区空间的当地志愿者。

phrases.english: to avoid attracting attention
phrases.exampleEnglish: She decided to keep a low profile during the first week while learning how the new team preferred to work.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她决定第一周保持低调，同时了解新团队偏好的工作方式。

senses.english: emotion or a state of mind; how you feel
senses.exampleEnglish: The cheerful music improved everyone's mood while we waited for the rain to stop outside the café.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在咖啡馆里等外面停雨时，欢快的音乐让大家的心情好了起来。

senses.english: the general feeling created by a place, event, or work of art
senses.exampleEnglish: Warm lighting changed the mood of the room, making the formal hall feel more welcoming during the evening event.
senses.exampleChinese: 温暖灯光改变了房间气氛，让正式大厅在晚间活动中更亲切。

phrases.english: feeling that you want to do something
phrases.exampleEnglish: I was not in the mood for a noisy restaurant after spending the whole day answering questions at the exhibition.
phrases.exampleChinese: 在展览答了一天问题后，我没心情去吵闹餐馆。

senses.english: show which is part of a larger story
senses.exampleEnglish: Each episode follows a different family as they try to reduce waste and save money at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 每一集都跟随一个不同的家庭，看他们如何尝试在家减少浪费并省钱。

senses.english: a particular event or period in someone's life
senses.exampleEnglish: She described the difficult episode honestly, including the mistakes that eventually taught her to ask for help sooner.
senses.exampleChinese: 她坦诚描述那段艰难经历，包括最终教会她更早求助的错误。

senses.english: to almost break something
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not pour boiling water into the cold glass because the sudden temperature change could make it crack.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要把开水倒进冷玻璃杯，因为温度突变可能使它裂开。

senses.english: a narrow line where something has broken but not separated completely
senses.exampleEnglish: A small crack appeared above the window after the heavy shelves were attached to the old wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 沉重架子装到旧墙上后，窗上方出现一条小裂缝。

senses.english: a sudden short sharp sound
senses.exampleEnglish: We heard a loud crack in the woods and stopped to see whether a branch had fallen nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们听到树林里一声脆响，便停下查看附近是否有树枝掉落。

senses.english: to solve a difficult problem, mystery, or code
senses.exampleEnglish: The students tried to crack the code by comparing repeated symbols before asking the teacher for another clue.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生先比较重复符号，尝试破解密码，再向老师要另一个提示。

phrases.english: to take stronger action against behaviour that breaks rules
phrases.exampleEnglish: The council plans to crack down on illegal parking because blocked entrances prevent residents from reaching their homes safely.
phrases.exampleChinese: 委员会计划严查违规停车，因为入口堵塞妨碍居民安全回家。

phrases.english: to start laughing strongly, used informally
phrases.exampleEnglish: We all began to crack up when the speaker described the harmless mistake she had made during her first lesson.
phrases.exampleChinese: 演讲者描述首课犯的无伤大雅错误时，我们都笑起来。

senses.english: existing in large numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: We received numerous suggestions after inviting residents to explain how they wanted the empty building to be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 邀请居民说明希望如何使用空置建筑后，我们收到了许多建议。

senses.english: to accept a superior force has power over you
senses.exampleEnglish: In the story, the villagers refuse to submit to a ruler who keeps changing the rules without warning.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事里，村民拒绝屈服于一位总是不事先通知就改变规则的统治者。

senses.english: to formally send or give something for consideration
senses.exampleEnglish: Please submit your application before Friday so that the committee can review every proposal during next week's meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在周五前提交申请，让委员会下周开会时能审阅每项提案。

senses.english: a change in someone or something that shows they have an illness or problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The leaflet describes a common symptom that readers might recognize, but advises them to seek professional guidance.
senses.exampleChinese: 这份传单描述了一种读者可能认出的常见症状，但建议他们寻求专业指导。

senses.english: a sign showing that a wider problem exists
senses.exampleEnglish: Frequent complaints may be a symptom of poor communication rather than evidence that the entire service needs replacing.
senses.exampleChinese: 频繁投诉可能是沟通不良的征兆，而不是整个服务需要更换的证据。

senses.english: almost completely
senses.exampleEnglish: After the new road opened, the journey became so short that traffic delays were virtually eliminated.
senses.exampleChinese: 新路开通后，路程变得很短，交通延误几乎消失了。

senses.english: using computer technology rather than being physically present
senses.exampleEnglish: The group met virtually because its members lived in different towns and could not travel during the working week.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组在线开会，因为成员住在不同城镇，工作日无法出行。

senses.english: a period of time in history that is special for a particular reason
senses.exampleEnglish: The photographs capture an era when most residents walked to work and few families owned a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些照片记录了一个多数居民步行上班、很少有家庭拥有汽车的时代。

senses.english: way a newspaper, television program, etc., reports an event or subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The channel's coverage of the festival included interviews with local artists as well as scenes from the performances.
senses.exampleChinese: 该频道的节日报道既包括对当地艺术家的采访，也包括演出画面。

senses.english: the protection provided by insurance
senses.exampleEnglish: Check the policy's coverage before travelling because some activities may not be included in the standard agreement.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅行前检查保单保障范围，因为某些活动可能不在标准协议内。

senses.english: the area or subjects reached by a service, report, or system
senses.exampleEnglish: Mobile coverage is weak near the campsite, so we agreed on a meeting point before leaving the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 营地附近手机信号覆盖差，因此离村前我们约好了会合点。

senses.english: feeling of anxiety and inability to relax
senses.exampleEnglish: A short break helped reduce the tension after the group struggled to agree on how to divide the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组难以就分工达成一致后，短暂休息有助于缓解紧张气氛。

senses.english: the force that stretches something tight
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor adjusted the tension of the strings before letting the students compare the sounds they produced.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练先调整弦的张力，再让学生比较它们发出的声音。

senses.english: wire carrying electricity, tv signals, internet, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Make sure the cable is long enough before moving the desk to the other side of the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 把书桌移到房间另一侧前，要确保电缆足够长。

senses.english: a thick strong rope, often made of metal wires
senses.exampleEnglish: A strong cable held the boat in place while workers repaired the damaged steps beside the water.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人修理水边受损台阶时，一根结实缆绳把船固定在原处。

senses.english: easily hurt or damaged
senses.exampleEnglish: The old photographs are sensitive to strong light, so the museum displays them only for short periods.
senses.exampleChinese: 老照片容易受强光损伤，因此博物馆只把它们短时间展出。

senses.english: requiring care because it may upset people or reveal private information
senses.exampleEnglish: We discussed the sensitive issue in a smaller meeting so that residents could speak without feeling exposed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在小型会议上讨论这个敏感问题，让居民能发言而不觉得隐私受暴露。

senses.english: able to notice or respond to very small changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The sensitive instrument detected a change that was too small for the class to notice without measuring it.
senses.exampleChinese: 灵敏仪器检测到一种变化，全班若不测量就难以察觉。

senses.english: having a tendency to become uneasy or anxious
senses.exampleEnglish: I felt nervous before the interview, but the welcoming receptionist helped me relax while I waited outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 面试前我很紧张，不过我在外等候时，热情的接待员帮我放松了下来。

senses.english: relating to the body's nerves
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explained how the nervous system carries information, using a diagram rather than complicated medical terms.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程用图示而非复杂医学术语，解释神经系统如何传递信息。

senses.english: to put in information, advice, or opinions
senses.exampleEnglish: Please input the address carefully because even a small mistake could send the package to another town.
senses.exampleChinese: 请仔细输入地址，因为即使一个小错误也可能让包裹被送到另一个镇。

senses.english: information, effort, or advice put into a process
senses.exampleEnglish: The design improved after we asked for input from people who would actually use the new waiting area.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们征求实际会使用新候车区的人提供意见后，设计得到改进。

senses.english: to keep in a place or situation apart from others
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers decided to isolate the damaged samples so that they would not be confused with the others.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究人员决定把受损样本分开，避免与其他样本混淆。

senses.english: to identify and separate one factor or part for study
senses.exampleEnglish: The students tried to isolate the cause of the failure by changing only one part of the experiment.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生每次只改实验的一个部分，试图单独确定失败原因。

senses.english: someone kept in a prison as punishment for a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary followed a former prisoner who was learning new skills and trying to rebuild his life.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部纪录片跟拍了一位前囚犯，他正在学习新技能，努力重建生活。

senses.english: to completely remove; to get rid of
senses.exampleEnglish: Checking the list together should eliminate most errors before we send the invitations to everyone taking part.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家一起核对名单，应该能在发出活动邀请前消除大部分错误。

senses.english: held together firmly; difficult to move
senses.exampleEnglish: The lid was so tight that I asked my brother to help me open the jar.
senses.exampleChinese: 盖子太紧了，我只好请哥哥帮忙打开罐子。

senses.english: fitting so closely that movement or space is limited
senses.exampleEnglish: The shoes felt tight after the long walk, so she changed into a more comfortable pair before dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途步行后鞋子很紧，因此她晚饭前换了一双更舒适的。

senses.english: having very little money, time, or room available
senses.exampleEnglish: Our budget is tight this month, so we are looking for activities that the whole family can enjoy free.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们这个月预算紧张，所以在找全家能免费享受的活动。

senses.english: carefully controlled and allowing little freedom or error
senses.exampleEnglish: The team kept tight control of the schedule because the hall had to be ready before visitors arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队严格控制进度，因为必须在游客到达前准备好大厅。

senses.english: firmly or closely, so that something cannot easily move
senses.exampleEnglish: Hold tight to the rail while stepping onto the boat, because it may move when another passenger gets aboard.
senses.exampleChinese: 踏上船时抓紧栏杆，因为其他乘客上船可能使它晃动。

phrases.english: a difficult situation with few easy choices
phrases.exampleEnglish: We were in a tight spot when the van broke down, since the equipment had to reach the hall before noon.
phrases.exampleChinese: 货车坏时我们陷入困境，因为设备中午前必须到大厅。

senses.english: covered or soaked with a liquid; not dry
senses.exampleEnglish: Our shoes were still wet after the walk, so we left them near the door overnight.
senses.exampleChinese: 步行后鞋子还湿着，因此我们把它们放在门边晾了一夜。

senses.english: having or bringing rain
senses.exampleEnglish: A wet afternoon kept us indoors, but we enjoyed looking through photographs from earlier trips together.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午下雨让我们留在室内，不过一起翻看以往旅行照片也很开心。

senses.english: to put liquid on something so that it becomes wet
senses.exampleEnglish: You should wet the cloth before wiping the surface, otherwise the dust may spread around the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 擦表面前应弄湿布，否则灰尘可能在房里散开。

phrases.english: a person who discourages others from enjoying themselves or trying something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Nobody wanted to be a wet blanket, but someone still needed to explain why the plan might be unsafe.
phrases.exampleChinese: 没人想扫兴，但仍需有人说明计划为何可能不安全。

senses.english: less important than something else
senses.exampleEnglish: Cost was a secondary concern because the committee first wanted to find the safest option for children.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用是次要问题，因为委员会首先希望找到对孩子最安全的方案。

senses.english: relating to education between primary school and higher education
senses.exampleEnglish: The programme helps primary pupils prepare for secondary school by introducing routines that they will meet next year.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目通过介绍明年会遇到的常规安排，帮助小学生准备进入中学。

senses.english: a government program to help poor people
senses.exampleEnglish: The report examines whether the welfare system gives enough support to families who temporarily lose their income.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告考察福利制度是否为暂时失去收入的家庭提供了足够支持。

senses.english: the health, happiness, and good conditions of people or animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The farm puts animal welfare first, even when providing extra space means keeping fewer animals on the same land.
senses.exampleChinese: 农场把动物福利放首位，即使增加空间意味着同样土地养更少动物。

senses.english: to get people to come and work, join, or study with you
senses.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to recruit more volunteers before the summer programme begins, especially people with practical gardening experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望在暑期项目开始前招募更多志愿者，尤其是有园艺实践经验的人。

senses.english: a person who has recently joined an organisation or team
senses.exampleEnglish: Each new recruit worked alongside an experienced volunteer until they felt confident answering visitors' questions without help.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位新成员先跟有经验的志愿者工作，直到有信心独立回答游客问题。

senses.english: to prevent someone from access to a group
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not exclude anyone from the discussion simply because they have less experience than other members.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不应仅仅因为某人经验比其他成员少，就把他们排除在讨论之外。

senses.english: to deliberately leave something out of consideration or a calculation
senses.exampleEnglish: The total will exclude delivery costs because customers can choose whether to collect their order in person.
senses.exampleChinese: 总价不包括配送费，因为顾客可选择是否亲自取货。

senses.english: thin rope
senses.exampleEnglish: Tie the parcel with string before carrying it downstairs so that the loose books cannot fall out.
senses.exampleChinese: 把包裹用细绳绑好再搬下楼，以免散放的书掉出来。

senses.english: a series of similar events or things
senses.exampleEnglish: A string of small mistakes delayed the project, although none of them would have caused serious trouble alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 一连串小错误拖延了项目，尽管单个错误都不至于造成严重麻烦。

senses.english: a thin cord on a musical instrument that vibrates to produce sound
senses.exampleEnglish: One string broke during the rehearsal, so the musician borrowed another instrument before the audience entered the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 排练时一根弦断了，因此乐手在观众进厅前借了另一把乐器。

senses.english: to place things on a string or stretch a cord between points
senses.exampleEnglish: The children helped string paper decorations across the room before the families arrived for the afternoon celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 家庭们来参加下午庆祝前，孩子们帮忙把纸装饰串挂在房间里。

phrases.english: to keep someone hoping by making misleading promises
phrases.exampleEnglish: The supplier should not string along customers with promises when it knows the missing parts cannot arrive this month.
phrases.exampleChinese: 明知缺件本月到不了，供应商就不该用承诺吊着客户。

phrases.english: to use personal influence to obtain a result
phrases.exampleEnglish: She refused to pull strings for her cousin because every applicant deserved to be judged by the same criteria.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她拒绝为堂弟动关系，因为每个申请者都应按同样标准评判。

senses.english: a mass of water vapor in the sky, as when it is going to rain
senses.exampleEnglish: A dark cloud appeared above the hills just as we were deciding whether to continue our walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 就在我们决定是否继续步行时，一朵乌云出现在山丘上方。

senses.english: to make something difficult to understand, judge, or see
senses.exampleEnglish: Try not to let one disappointing result cloud your judgement of the progress the whole team has made.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要让一次令人失望的结果，影响你判断整个团队取得的进步。

phrases.english: extremely happy, used informally
phrases.exampleEnglish: Ella was on cloud nine after hearing that her photograph would appear in the town's annual exhibition.
phrases.exampleChinese: 听说照片将参加城镇年度展后，艾拉欣喜若狂。

senses.english: to get you to do/believe something, by giving reasons
senses.exampleEnglish: We managed to persuade our neighbour to join the walk by explaining that the route was quite gentle.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们说明这条路线相当平缓，成功说服邻居一起散步。

senses.english: to make someone have the desire to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher hopes to inspire her students by showing them how ordinary people can solve difficult community problems.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师希望通过展示普通人如何解决困难的社区问题，来激励学生。

senses.english: very large or impressive in appearance
senses.exampleEnglish: The old station has a grand entrance that reminds visitors how important railway travel once was.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧车站拥有宏伟的入口，让游客想起铁路旅行曾经多么重要。

senses.english: including everything in a total or overall plan
senses.exampleEnglish: The grand total was higher than expected because several small charges had been missing from our first calculation.
senses.exampleChinese: 总额比预期高，因为首次计算漏掉了几笔小额费用。

senses.chinese: 一千英镑或美元（非正式）
senses.english: one thousand pounds or dollars, used informally
senses.exampleEnglish: The repairs cost two grand, which was still less than buying a replacement that would last as long.
senses.exampleChinese: 修理花了两千，但仍比买一件同样耐用的替代品便宜。

senses.english: from now, later than the present time
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum will reopen two weeks hence, once workers have finished repairing the entrance and replacing the lighting.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆将在两周后重新开放，届时工人将完成入口修缮及照明更换。

senses.english: for this reason, used especially in formal writing
senses.exampleEnglish: The route passes through several villages, hence its popularity with walkers who prefer regular places to stop.
senses.exampleChinese: 路线经过几个村庄，因此深受喜欢途中经常有歇脚点的步行者欢迎。

senses.english: an organized group of workers (e.g., on a ship)
senses.exampleEnglish: The crew checked the lifeboats carefully before passengers were allowed to board the ship for the evening crossing.
senses.exampleChinese: 乘客获准登船参加晚间航程之前，船员们仔细检查了救生艇。

senses.english: a fact that can be observed and studied
senses.exampleEnglish: The students investigated a natural phenomenon that occurs when sunlight passes through tiny drops of water.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们研究了一种自然现象，它发生在阳光穿过微小水滴时。

senses.english: a child or young person being taught at school
senses.exampleEnglish: Each pupil chose a favourite book and explained to a partner why they thought it was worth reading.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位小学生选了一本喜欢的书，并向同伴说明为什么值得读。

senses.english: the dark round opening in the centre of the eye
senses.exampleEnglish: The diagram shows how the pupil changes size when a person moves from bright sunlight into a darker room.
senses.exampleChinese: 图示展示了人从强烈阳光走入暗室时，瞳孔如何改变大小。

senses.english: not real or true
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice contained false information about the opening hours, so several visitors arrived after the building had closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 通知中的开放时间信息不实，因此几位游客到达时建筑已经关闭。

senses.english: made to look real, although not natural or genuine
senses.exampleEnglish: The actor wore a false beard because the character was supposed to look much older in the final scene.
senses.exampleChinese: 演员戴假胡子，因为最后一幕里角色应该显得老得多。

phrases.english: a warning that turns out not to indicate real danger
phrases.exampleEnglish: It was a false alarm, but the staff still checked the building before allowing visitors to return to the hall.
phrases.exampleChinese: 虽是误报，员工仍检查建筑后才让游客回大厅。

senses.english: to help
senses.exampleEnglish: A member of staff will assist you with the form if any of the questions are unclear.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果表格上有任何问题不清楚，工作人员会协助你填写。

senses.english: a pass or action that directly helps another player score
senses.exampleEnglish: Her accurate assist gave the youngest player a chance to score during the final minutes of the match.
senses.exampleChinese: 比赛最后几分钟，她精准的助攻让最年轻的球员获得进球机会。

senses.english: to put or bring back into existence or use, mend
senses.exampleEnglish: The town plans to restore the old theatre so that local groups can use it for performances again.
senses.exampleChinese: 镇里计划修复旧剧院，让当地团体能再次在那里演出。

senses.english: plan, rule, or method for doing or making something
senses.exampleEnglish: The chef developed a simple formula for planning meals that kept costs low without making the menu repetitive.
senses.exampleChinese: 厨师制定了一套简单的配餐方法，既控制成本，又不让菜单重复单调。

senses.english: a rule expressed using numbers or symbols
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to explain the formula in words before using it to calculate the missing distance.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们先用文字解释公式，再用它计算缺失的距离。

senses.english: a specially prepared milk product for feeding babies
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop keeps infant formula behind the counter because parents often ask staff to find a particular product.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店把婴儿配方奶放柜台后，因为家长常请员工寻找特定产品。

senses.english: to make a change to something
senses.exampleEnglish: We may need to alter the schedule if the earlier train arrives too late for the first session.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果前一班火车的到达时间赶不上第一场活动，我们可能需要调整日程。

senses.english: to notice or become aware of something
senses.exampleEnglish: People may perceive the same colour differently when it appears against a lighter or darker background.
senses.exampleChinese: 当同一种颜色出现在较浅或较深的背景上时，人们的感知可能不同。

senses.english: a usual set of actions followed regularly
senses.exampleEnglish: Adding a short walk to my morning routine helped me feel more awake before starting work at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 把短时间散步加入早晨的日常安排，让我在开始居家办公前更清醒。

senses.english: done regularly as part of a usual procedure
senses.exampleEnglish: A routine check revealed the loose handle before anyone tried to carry the heavy box upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 例行检查发现把手松动，避免有人用它搬重箱子上楼。

senses.english: to go down below the surface of water, mud, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: If the small boat begins to sink, the passengers must follow the crew's instructions rather than panic.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果小船开始下沉，乘客必须遵从船员指示，而不是惊慌失措。

senses.english: to move to a lower level, amount, or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: Her confidence began to sink after several unsuccessful attempts, until a friend suggested a simpler way to practise.
senses.exampleChinese: 几次尝试失败后，她的信心开始下降，直到朋友建议更简单的练习方法。

senses.english: a bowl-shaped fixture with water taps used for washing
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave the cups beside the sink until we have finished using the kitchen to prepare lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把杯子放在水槽旁，等我们用厨房准备完午餐再洗。

phrases.english: to become fully understood, often after some time
phrases.exampleEnglish: The news took a while to sink in because nobody had expected the small team to win the competition.
phrases.exampleChinese: 消息过一会儿才被领会，因为没人预料小队会赢比赛。

senses.english: to look at someone or something for a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: It is difficult to concentrate when people stare at you, even if they are only curious about your work.
senses.exampleChinese: 有人盯着你看时很难集中注意力，即使他们只是对你的工作好奇。

senses.english: a long fixed look at someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: His puzzled stare made me realise that I had skipped an important step while explaining the instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 他困惑的凝视让我意识到，解释说明时我漏掉了关键步骤。

senses.english: no longer; no more
senses.exampleEnglish: We do not print the weekly timetable anymore because most visitors prefer to check updates on their phones.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不再打印每周时间表，因为多数游客更愿意在手机上查看更新。

senses.english: person of great courage and strength who saves others
senses.exampleEnglish: The story's hero succeeds by listening to others rather than pretending that he can solve every problem alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事的主人公通过倾听他人而成功，而不是假装自己能独力解决所有问题。

senses.english: the main male character in a story
senses.exampleEnglish: The hero makes several mistakes before learning that listening to his friends matters more than appearing completely fearless.
senses.exampleChinese: 主人公犯了几次错，才学会倾听朋友比显得无所畏惧更重要。

senses.english: someone who shows they are in favor of an idea/plan
senses.exampleEnglish: As a long-time supporter of the library, she helped organise an event to raise money for new books.
senses.exampleChinese: 作为图书馆的长期支持者，她帮助组织了一场为购置新书筹款的活动。

senses.english: to change form, character, or function to another
senses.exampleEnglish: We plan to convert the empty shop into a community room where neighbours can meet and share skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计划把空商店改成社区活动室，让邻居们见面并交流技能。

senses.english: a person who has changed to a new religion, belief, or habit
senses.exampleEnglish: She became a convert to cycling after discovering that the riverside route made the daily journey more enjoyable.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现河边路线让日常通勤更愉快后，她成了骑行的支持者。

senses.english: firmly fixed, supported, or balanced; not shaking, rocking, or likely to fall over
senses.exampleEnglish: Hold the ladder steady while I reach the top shelf, otherwise the box may fall onto the floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 我够顶层架子时，请扶稳梯子，否则箱子可能会掉到地上。

senses.english: continuing at a regular rate without large changes
senses.exampleEnglish: A steady stream of visitors arrived throughout the morning, so volunteers took turns resting rather than stopping together.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个上午游客稳定不断地到来，因此志愿者轮流休息，而非一起停下。

senses.english: to stop someone or something shaking or losing balance
senses.exampleEnglish: He held the rail to steady himself before stepping from the moving boat onto the narrow platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 他扶着栏杆稳住自己，再从晃动的船踏上狭窄平台。

senses.english: unit of length equal to 100 cm or about 39 inches
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow path was less than a meter wide, so we had to walk one behind another.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条狭窄的小路不到一米宽，因此我们只能一个接一个地走。

senses.english: a device that measures an amount, rate, or use of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new meter records water use more accurately, helping residents notice leaks before they receive an unexpectedly large bill.
senses.exampleChinese: 新水表更准确记录用水量，帮助居民在账单意外增大前发现漏水。

senses.english: a large road vehicle used to carry things
senses.exampleEnglish: A truck blocked the entrance while workers unloaded the chairs that we needed for the afternoon event.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人卸下午活动需要的椅子时，一辆卡车挡住了入口。

senses.english: part of the face used for breathing and smelling
senses.exampleEnglish: The child held his nose because the strong smell from the paint made him feel uncomfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子捂住鼻子，因为油漆的刺鼻气味让他觉得不舒服。

senses.english: the front part of an aircraft or similar object
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide pointed to the nose of the aircraft while explaining where the pilots sat during the flight.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游指着飞机机头，解释飞行时驾驶员坐在哪里。

senses.english: to look around curiously, sometimes where you are not wanted
senses.exampleEnglish: The reporter tried to nose around the workshop before the owner had agreed to answer questions about the new design.
senses.exampleChinese: 业主未答应回答新设计问题前，记者试图在工坊四处探查。

phrases.english: in an obvious nearby place that you have failed to notice
phrases.exampleEnglish: The key may be right under your nose, so check the papers on your desk before searching the whole house.
phrases.exampleChinese: 钥匙可能就在眼前，先查桌上文件再搜全屋。

phrases.english: to reject something because you consider it not good enough
phrases.exampleEnglish: You should not turn your nose up at second-hand furniture when the pieces are strong and suit the room perfectly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 二手家具结实又适合房间时，不该嫌弃它们。

senses.english: by the side of something; next to something
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a quiet place beside the river where we could eat lunch and watch the passing boats.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在河边找了个安静的地方，可以吃午饭、看船来来往往。

senses.english: to travel on water in a ship or boat
senses.exampleEnglish: We hoped to sail around the island, but strong winds meant we had to postpone the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们希望绕岛航行，但强风让我们不得不推迟行程。

senses.english: a large piece of strong cloth that catches wind to move a boat
senses.exampleEnglish: The crew lowered the sail as the wind strengthened, following the captain's instructions before entering the sheltered harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 风增强时，船员遵从船长指示降下船帆，再驶入避风港。

phrases.english: to succeed at something without much difficulty
phrases.exampleEnglish: She expected to sail through the test, but the final section required more careful thinking than she had practised.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她以为能轻松过考，不过最后部分需要比练习更细的思考。

senses.english: something that causes a lot of harm or damage
senses.exampleEnglish: The community centre became a temporary shelter after the disaster left many families unable to return home.
senses.exampleChinese: 灾难导致许多家庭无法返家后，社区中心成了临时避难所。

senses.english: an event or situation that goes extremely badly
senses.exampleEnglish: The first rehearsal was a disaster because nobody understood the new schedule, but the next attempt went much better.
senses.exampleChinese: 首次彩排很糟，因为没人懂新日程，不过下次尝试顺利多了。

senses.english: the speed at which someone or something moves or happens
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked at a comfortable pace so that everyone could enjoy the views without feeling rushed or tired.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们以舒适的速度步行，让每个人都能欣赏风景，而不感到匆忙或疲惫。

senses.english: to walk backwards and forwards, often because of worry
senses.exampleEnglish: He began to pace outside the office while waiting to hear whether the interview had gone well.
senses.exampleChinese: 等待面试结果时，他开始在办公室外来回踱步。

phrases.english: to develop or move as quickly as someone or something else
phrases.exampleEnglish: The training programme must keep pace with changes in the equipment that workers use during their daily tasks.
phrases.exampleChinese: 培训必须跟上工人日常设备的变化。

senses.english: a lot or to a great degree
senses.exampleEnglish: It rained heavily throughout the morning, so the organisers moved most of the activities into the sports hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个上午都下着大雨，因此组织者把大部分活动移到了体育馆。

senses.english: to decide to use or give something for something else
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to devote one evening a week to helping neighbours practise the language they were learning.
senses.exampleChinese: 她决定每周抽出一个晚上，帮助邻居练习正在学习的语言。

senses.english: a person who uses fear or violence for a political purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The article examined how communities rebuilt trust after a terrorist attack without blaming people for their background.
senses.exampleChinese: 这篇文章探讨了恐怖袭击后社区如何重建信任，同时不因人们的背景而责怪他们。

senses.english: to give reasons why you did something or why it is right
senses.exampleEnglish: You will need to justify the extra expense by explaining how the new equipment will improve our work.
senses.exampleChinese: 你需要解释新设备如何改善工作，以证明这项额外支出的合理性。

senses.english: to adjust spacing so that text lines have straight edges
senses.exampleEnglish: You can justify the text before printing, although narrow columns may then contain spaces that look too large.
senses.exampleChinese: 打印前可把文本两端对齐，不过窄栏中可能出现过大的空格。

senses.english: necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: Reliable transport is vital for residents who need to reach work, shops, or medical appointments outside the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 对于需要去村外上班、购物或就医的居民来说，可靠的交通至关重要。

senses.english: attract or interest greatly
senses.exampleEnglish: Stories about distant planets fascinate the children because they raise questions that even scientists are still exploring.
senses.exampleChinese: 遥远行星的故事令孩子们着迷，因为它们提出的问题连科学家也仍在探索。

senses.english: outside of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The external doors will remain locked while the building is closed, but staff can enter through the side entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑关闭期间，外门将保持锁闭，但员工可从侧门进入。

senses.english: kept as something extra that can be used if it is needed
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep a spare key with someone you trust in case you accidentally lock yourself out of the house.
senses.exampleChinese: 把备用钥匙交给一个信任的人，以防你不小心把自己锁在门外。

senses.english: available for use because it is not needed for work or another purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: She spends her spare time helping at the library, where she enjoys recommending books to younger readers.
senses.exampleChinese: 她利用空闲时间在图书馆帮忙，喜欢给年轻读者推荐书籍。

senses.english: to give time or resources, or save someone from an unpleasant experience
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you spare ten minutes to check the instructions before we send them to all the volunteers?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能抽十分钟检查说明，再让我们发给所有志愿者吗？

senses.english: an extra item kept to replace one that is lost or damaged
senses.exampleEnglish: We carried a spare in the van because replacing a damaged wheel would be difficult on the remote road.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在货车里带了备用轮胎，因为偏远路上换受损车轮很困难。

senses.english: to prevent someone from experiencing something unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: A clearer message could spare visitors a wasted journey by explaining that the building is closed for repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 更清楚的消息说明建筑修缮关闭，就能让游客免于白跑。

senses.english: at any or every time that
senses.exampleEnglish: You can contact the support team whenever you need help, although replies may take longer at weekends.
senses.exampleChinese: 你需要帮助时随时可以联系支持团队，不过周末回复可能较慢。

senses.english: a feeling of great sadness
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel describes her depression with care, showing how difficult it becomes to enjoy activities she once loved.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说细致地描写了她的抑郁，展现她难以再享受曾经热爱的活动。

senses.english: a long period of very low economic activity and high unemployment
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how the depression affected local families when several factories closed and other work was scarce.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释了工厂关闭、其他工作稀缺时，经济萧条如何影响当地家庭。

senses.english: an area lower than the surrounding surface
senses.exampleEnglish: Water collected in a shallow depression beside the path, attracting birds after the rest of the ground dried.
senses.exampleChinese: 水积在小路旁的浅凹地里，其余地面干后仍吸引鸟类。

senses.english: having done something bad or illegal
senses.exampleEnglish: He felt guilty about forgetting the meeting because his colleague had spent the morning preparing for it.
senses.exampleChinese: 他因忘记会议而内疚，因为同事为此准备了整个上午。

senses.english: having committed an offence, especially as decided by a court
senses.exampleEnglish: The court found him guilty after examining evidence that the defence and prosecution had both presented during the trial.
senses.exampleChinese: 法庭审查了审判中控辩双方提交的证据后，认定他有罪。

senses.english: to lie or exist beneath
senses.exampleEnglish: Layers of older rock underlie the town, which explains why the builders requested a detailed geological survey.
senses.exampleChinese: 更古老的岩层位于城镇下方，这说明建筑人员为何要求进行详细地质勘测。

collocations.chinese: 位于某地区下方的岩石

senses.english: to be the basic cause or principle behind something
senses.exampleEnglish: Different concerns may underlie the complaints, so the team should listen carefully before offering the same solution to everyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 投诉背后可能有不同顾虑，因此团队应先认真听，再决定是否给所有人同样方案。

senses.english: mother
senses.exampleEnglish: My mom taught me to check the whole recipe before cooking so that I would not forget important ingredients.
senses.exampleChinese: 妈妈教我做饭前先看完整个食谱，以免漏掉重要食材。

senses.english: the special quality that makes something different
senses.exampleEnglish: The course makes a clear distinction between checking facts and expressing opinions, although both are important skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程明确区分核查事实与表达观点，尽管两者都是重要技能。

senses.english: special excellence or a high mark awarded for strong work
senses.exampleEnglish: She completed the course with distinction after balancing difficult assignments with the demands of a full-time job.
senses.exampleChinese: 她兼顾艰难作业和全职工作后，以优等成绩完成了课程。

senses.english: happy feeling because of something that you did
senses.exampleEnglish: There was real satisfaction in seeing the empty courtyard become a garden that everyone in the building could enjoy.
senses.exampleChinese: 看着空院子变成楼里每个人都能享用的花园，确实让人满足。

senses.english: to include or involve as part of something else
senses.exampleEnglish: We should incorporate the students' suggestions into the final design because they will use the room every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该把学生的建议纳入最终设计，因为他们每天都会使用这个房间。

senses.english: to make a liquid flow from one container into another
senses.exampleEnglish: Please pour the juice into smaller glasses so that every child can have some before we open another carton.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把果汁倒进小杯子，让每个孩子都先喝到一些，然后再开另一盒。

senses.english: to rain heavily or flow in large quantities
senses.exampleEnglish: It began to pour just as the visitors arrived, so volunteers quickly guided everyone into the covered hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客到达时开始下倾盆大雨，因此志愿者迅速引导大家进有顶棚的大厅。

phrases.english: to arrive in large numbers or amounts
phrases.exampleEnglish: Offers of help began to pour in after residents saw photographs showing the damage to their local library.
phrases.exampleChinese: 居民看到当地图书馆受损照片后，援助提议大量涌来。

senses.english: to remove dust or dirt from a surface with a broom or brush
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to sweep the floor before moving the furniture back, otherwise dust will collect under the heavy shelves.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬回家具前需要扫地，否则灰尘会积在沉重的架子下面。

senses.english: to move strongly and quickly across an area
senses.exampleEnglish: Strong winds can sweep across the open plain, so the guide advised us to carry an extra layer.
senses.exampleChinese: 强风会掠过开阔平原，因此导游建议我们多带一件衣服。

senses.english: a wide movement or range extending across an area
senses.exampleEnglish: With one sweep of her arm, the guide showed how far the old harbour had extended inland.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游挥臂一指，展示旧港曾向内陆延伸多远。

phrases.english: to remove something completely or carry it away forcefully
phrases.exampleEnglish: The successful rehearsal helped sweep away our doubts about whether the younger students were ready for the final performance.
phrases.exampleChinese: 彩排成功一扫我们对低年级学生是否准备好正式演出的疑虑。

senses.english: something that you do because it is your duty or because you feel you have to
senses.exampleEnglish: Taking care of shared equipment is everyone's obligation, since another group will need to use it tomorrow.
senses.exampleChinese: 爱护共用设备是每个人的义务，因为明天另一个小组还需要使用。

senses.english: form of address to a man you respect
senses.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, sir, could you move your bag so that the passenger beside you has enough space?
senses.exampleChinese: 打扰一下，先生，您能挪一下包，让旁边的乘客有足够空间吗？

senses.english: to form an idea to judge something carefully
senses.exampleEnglish: The team will evaluate each proposal by comparing its cost, likely benefits, and effect on the surrounding neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队将通过比较成本、预期效益及对周边社区的影响，评估每项提案。

senses.english: to make someone mad, upset, or annoyed
senses.exampleEnglish: Sudden changes to the timetable may anger passengers who have already arranged their journeys around the published schedule.
senses.exampleChinese: 时刻表突然变动可能激怒已经按公布时间安排好行程的乘客。

senses.english: the strong feeling caused by something unfair or upsetting
senses.exampleEnglish: Her anger faded when the assistant explained that the cancellation was necessary because the building was unsafe.
senses.exampleChinese: 助理解释因建筑不安全必须取消活动后，她的怒气消了。

senses.english: a place that sells alcohol and food
senses.exampleEnglish: We met at a quiet pub near the station because it served reasonably priced meals throughout the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在车站附近一家安静的酒吧见面，因为那里整晚供应价格合理的饭菜。

senses.english: the way in which one sees or understands something
senses.exampleEnglish: Travelling through the region changed my perception of it because everyday life differed greatly from the television reports.
senses.exampleChinese: 穿行这个地区改变了我对它的看法，因为日常生活与电视报道差别很大。

senses.english: the ability to notice things through the senses
senses.exampleEnglish: The experiment explored depth perception by asking students to judge which objects were nearer without moving their heads.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验让学生不动头判断哪些物体更近，以探索深度知觉。

senses.english: as someone would expect; not surprising
senses.exampleEnglish: After weeks of practising the route, she naturally felt more confident about cycling to work on her own.
senses.exampleChinese: 练习这条路线几周后，她自然对独自骑车上班更有信心了。

senses.english: without artificial help, or as a result of an inborn ability
senses.exampleEnglish: Some people speak naturally in front of an audience, while others become comfortable only after plenty of practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 有些人天生面对观众讲话很自然，另一些人则要充分练习才自在。

senses.english: a money system that a country uses
senses.exampleEnglish: Check which currency the website uses before paying, since the displayed price may not include conversion charges.
senses.exampleChinese: 付款前请检查网站使用哪种货币，因为显示的价格可能不含兑换费用。

senses.english: the state of being widely believed, accepted, or used
senses.exampleEnglish: The idea gained currency after several schools reported that the same approach had improved their students' confidence.
senses.exampleChinese: 几所学校报告同样方法提升学生信心后，这个想法得到广泛接受。

senses.english: information stored in a computer in an organized way
senses.exampleEnglish: The library uses a database to record which books are available and when borrowed copies should be returned.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆用数据库记录哪些书可借，以及借出的书何时应归还。

senses.english: at the beginning
senses.exampleEnglish: We initially planned a larger event, but the limited space persuaded us to invite fewer people this time.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们最初计划举办更大的活动，但空间有限，让我们决定这次少邀请一些人。

senses.english: area of land or ocean owned or controlled by a government or person
senses.exampleEnglish: The old map shows how the kingdom's territory changed as rivers shifted and neighbouring rulers signed new agreements.
senses.exampleChinese: 这幅老地图展示了河流改道、邻国统治者签订新协议后，王国领土如何变化。

senses.english: an area of knowledge, activity, or experience
senses.exampleEnglish: Designing for children was new territory for the team, so they began by observing how pupils used the classroom.
senses.exampleChinese: 为儿童设计对团队是新领域，因此先观察学生如何使用教室。

senses.english: small river
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed the stream through the woods until we reached a small bridge near the village entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿着溪流穿过树林，直到来到村口附近的一座小桥。

senses.english: a continuous flow of people, things, or events
senses.exampleEnglish: A stream of messages arrived after the announcement, making it difficult for the small team to reply immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 公告后消息接连而来，小团队难以立即回复。

senses.english: to send or receive sound and video continuously over the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: The library will stream the talk so that residents who cannot travel can still take part from home.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆将在线直播讲座，让无法出行的居民在家参与。

senses.english: to flow continuously, or move in a continuous line
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors began to stream through the gates once the rain stopped and the afternoon performances were ready to begin.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨停、下午演出准备开始后，游客开始涌入大门。

senses.english: in an infrequent manner
senses.exampleEnglish: We rarely eat at restaurants during the week because cooking together helps us relax after a busy day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们平日很少下馆子，因为一起做饭能帮助我们在忙碌一天后放松。

senses.english: distance of something from the bottom to the top
senses.exampleEnglish: Measure the height of the doorway before buying the cupboard, otherwise you may struggle to carry it inside.
senses.exampleChinese: 买柜子前先测量门口高度，否则可能很难把它搬进去。

senses.english: the time when something is strongest or most active
senses.exampleEnglish: At the height of the festival, extra buses helped visitors reach the village without blocking the narrow roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 节庆最热闹时，加开公交帮助游客到村里而不堵塞狭路。

senses.english: easy to see or clearly understand
senses.exampleEnglish: The reason for the delay became apparent when we saw workers repairing a damaged section of the track.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看见工人正在维修受损轨道后，延误的原因就很明显了。

senses.english: appearing to be true although it may not be
senses.exampleEnglish: Despite its apparent simplicity, the design required careful testing before the team could produce a reliable working model.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计虽然看似简单，团队仍需仔细测试才能做出可靠模型。

senses.english: coming from, found in, or facing towards the west
senses.exampleEnglish: The western side of the island faces the open sea, so it is usually windier than the sheltered harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 岛的西侧面向外海，因此通常比避风的港口风更大。

senses.english: act of expanding or becoming bigger
senses.exampleEnglish: The expansion of the library created more study space without changing the appearance of the original building.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆的扩建增加了学习空间，同时没有改变原建筑的外观。

senses.english: happening a lot or all the time
senses.exampleEnglish: The staff constantly check the weather during outdoor events so that they can respond quickly if conditions change.
senses.exampleChinese: 户外活动期间，工作人员不断查看天气，以便在情况变化时迅速应对。

senses.english: a body tissue that can become longer or shorter and moves the body
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach explained which muscle was working during the exercise so that students could understand the movement better.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练解释了练习时哪块肌肉在发力，让学生更好地理解动作。

senses.english: the power or resources needed to influence a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The small organisation lacked the financial muscle to advertise widely, so it relied on recommendations from satisfied customers.
senses.exampleChinese: 小机构缺乏广泛宣传的财力，因此依靠满意顾客推荐。

senses.english: to make someone feel frightened or worried
senses.exampleEnglish: Loud fireworks can scare animals, which is why the organisers warned nearby residents before the evening display.
senses.exampleChinese: 响亮的烟花声会吓到动物，因此组织者在晚间表演前提前通知了附近居民。

senses.english: a situation that causes sudden fear or public worry
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing bag gave us a scare until a volunteer explained that it had been moved somewhere safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 丢失的包让我们虚惊一场，直到志愿者说明包被移到了安全地方。

senses.english: not in a good way; not as wanted or liked
senses.exampleEnglish: The first attempt went badly because we had not checked whether all the equipment was working properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次尝试很不顺利，因为我们没有检查所有设备是否都能正常工作。

senses.english: to a serious degree or with a great need
senses.exampleEnglish: The roof was badly damaged during the storm, so the library could not reopen until repairs were complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 屋顶在风暴中严重受损，因此图书馆必须修好后才能重开。

phrases.english: having little money or few resources
phrases.exampleEnglish: The family was badly off after the shop closed, but neighbours helped them find temporary work in the area.
phrases.exampleChinese: 商店关闭后这家人经济拮据，但邻居帮他们在附近找到临工。

senses.english: used or seen daily; suitable for daily use; ordinary
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition uses everyday objects to show how families cooked, travelled, and communicated a hundred years ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览通过日常物品，展示一百年前的家庭如何做饭、出行和沟通。

senses.english: where one area ends and another begins
senses.exampleEnglish: A low stone wall marks the boundary between the public garden and the farmer's private field.
senses.exampleChinese: 一道矮石墙标出了公共花园与农民私人田地之间的边界。

senses.english: two numbers that show ​the relationship between two groups of people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher changed the ratio of discussion to written work after students asked for more speaking practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生要求增加口语练习后，老师调整了讨论与书面作业的比例。

collocations.english: the ratio of one thing to another

senses.english: short written work that displays someone's opinions or beliefs regarding a particular subject
senses.exampleEnglish: My essay compares two ways of reducing traffic and explains why one might work better in small towns.
senses.exampleChinese: 我的文章比较了两种减轻交通拥堵的方法，并解释其中一种为何可能更适合小城镇。

senses.english: to make a sudden loud cry
senses.exampleEnglish: The children began to scream with excitement when the enormous fountain suddenly sent water high above the square.
senses.exampleChinese: 巨大的喷泉突然把水喷向广场上空时，孩子们兴奋地尖叫起来。

senses.english: a loud high cry of fear, excitement, or pain
senses.exampleEnglish: A scream came from the playground when the water unexpectedly sprayed across the children waiting near the fountain.
senses.exampleChinese: 水意外喷到喷泉旁等候的孩子身上时，游乐场传来一声尖叫。

senses.english: pull back; move away or backward from something
senses.exampleEnglish: You can withdraw cash at the station, but remember that some machines may charge an additional fee.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以在车站取现金，不过要记住有些机器可能收取额外费用。

senses.english: to remove something or stop taking part in a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The company decided to withdraw the advertisement after customers pointed out that its wording could easily be misunderstood.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客指出措辞易被误解后，公司决定撤回广告。

senses.english: dirty or dangerous waste released into an environment
senses.exampleEnglish: The town reduced air pollution by improving buses and making it easier for residents to cycle safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 镇里通过改善公交、方便居民安全骑车，减少了空气污染。

senses.english: a lack of organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The files were in such disorder that we spent most of the morning finding the documents we needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 文件乱得一团糟，我们花了大半个上午才找到需要的材料。

senses.english: a condition that affects normal physical or mental functioning
senses.exampleEnglish: The article described a sleep disorder without suggesting that every person who sometimes sleeps badly has the same condition.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章介绍一种睡眠障碍，但未暗示偶尔睡不好的人都有同样问题。

senses.english: items such as tables, chairs, beds, or closets
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose lighter furniture so that the room could be rearranged quickly for meetings, classes, or community meals.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选择较轻的家具，让房间能迅速重新布置，用于会议、课程或社区聚餐。

senses.english: action or object that represents a particular idea or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The restored bridge became a symbol of cooperation after neighbours from both sides helped rebuild it together.
senses.exampleChinese: 两岸邻居共同参与重建后，修复的桥成了合作的象征。

senses.english: set of rooms to live in on one floor of a building
senses.exampleEnglish: Their new apartment is smaller, but the shorter journey to work gives them more time together every evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的新公寓更小，不过通勤变短，让他们每晚有更多相处时间。

senses.english: explanation of how something works
senses.exampleEnglish: After a short demonstration, visitors were invited to try the equipment while an instructor answered their questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 简短示范之后，游客获邀试用设备，教练则在旁回答问题。

senses.english: a public gathering where people express strong support or opposition
senses.exampleEnglish: The peaceful demonstration called for safer crossings near schools, where families had reported several dangerous incidents.
senses.exampleChinese: 和平示威要求学校附近有更安全的过街设施，因为家庭已报告几次险情。

senses.english: someone who is skilled at studying the details of data
senses.exampleEnglish: The analyst compared several months of sales figures before suggesting why demand had changed in certain regions.
senses.exampleChinese: 分析师比较了几个月的销售数据，然后才提出某些地区需求变化的原因。

senses.english: a raised area for people to stand on
senses.exampleEnglish: Please wait behind the line on the platform until the train has stopped and passengers have stepped off.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在站台线后等候，直到列车停稳、乘客下车。

senses.english: a system that supports software, services, or online communication
senses.exampleEnglish: The school chose a platform that lets teachers share materials without asking families to create several separate accounts.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校选了一个让教师共享资料的平台，不必让家长建多个账户。

senses.english: an opportunity or place to make ideas known to an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival gave young artists a platform to discuss problems that rarely appeared in the local news.
senses.exampleChinese: 节日为年轻艺术家提供发声机会，讨论当地新闻很少报道的问题。

senses.english: the stated policies that a political group supports
senses.exampleEnglish: The party's platform included better rural transport, which attracted residents who struggled to reach work without a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 该党政纲包括改善乡村交通，吸引不开车难以上班的居民。

senses.english: very strong metal made of iron and other substances mixed together
senses.exampleEnglish: The new bridge uses steel supports because they can carry heavy loads while leaving more space beneath.
senses.exampleChinese: 新桥采用钢支架，因为它们可以承受重载，同时留出更大的下方空间。

senses.chinese: 使坚定；使做好心理准备
senses.english: to make yourself ready for something difficult or unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: She had to steel herself before explaining the decision, knowing that several disappointed colleagues would ask difficult questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明决定前，她必须做好心理准备，因为几位失望同事会提出难答问题。

senses.english: a sweet baked food made from flour, eggs, fat, and sugar
senses.exampleEnglish: We kept the cake in a cool cupboard until all the guests had arrived for the birthday celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把蛋糕放在阴凉的柜子里，直到所有客人都到齐参加生日庆祝。

senses.english: to change the shape of something completely
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers hope to transform the neglected yard into a colourful garden where neighbours can spend time together.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者希望把荒废的院子改造成多彩的花园，让邻居们能聚在一起。

collocations.chinese: 把某物彻底变成另一物

senses.english: an injury to the body that is caused when something breaks the skin
senses.exampleEnglish: The character hid a small wound on his hand because he did not want to worry his companions.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个角色藏起了手上的小伤口，因为他不想让同伴担心。

senses.english: to injure someone physically or emotionally
senses.exampleEnglish: Careless remarks can wound people who are trying something unfamiliar, even when the speaker intends them as a joke.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使出于玩笑，轻率言语也可能伤害正在尝试陌生事物的人。

senses.english: a rule or law that limits what people can do
senses.exampleEnglish: The new restriction applies only during rush hour, when delivery vehicles often block the narrow shopping street.
senses.exampleChinese: 新限制只在高峰时段适用，那时送货车辆常常堵塞狭窄的购物街。

senses.english: underground base on which a building is constructed
senses.exampleEnglish: Builders checked the foundation carefully before adding another floor, since the extra weight could affect the whole building.
senses.exampleChinese: 加建一层之前，建筑工仔细检查了地基，因为增加的重量可能影响整栋建筑。

senses.english: an organisation created to support a useful cause with money or other help
senses.exampleEnglish: The foundation supports projects that give young people practical skills they can use in their own communities.
senses.exampleChinese: 基金会支持让年轻人获得可用于本社区的实用技能的项目。

senses.english: the basic ideas or conditions on which something develops
senses.exampleEnglish: Mutual trust provides a foundation for cooperation, especially when the team must make difficult decisions under pressure.
senses.exampleChinese: 相互信任是合作基础，特别是在团队要承压作艰难决定时。

senses.english: a skin-coloured cosmetic used on the face before other makeup
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a light foundation that matched her skin rather than using a heavier product for the photograph.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选择与肤色相配的轻薄粉底，而非为拍照使用更厚重的产品。

senses.english: someone who creates plans to make something
senses.exampleEnglish: The designer asked residents how they used the space before drawing plans for the new community centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计师先询问居民如何使用这片空间，再绘制新社区中心的设计图。

senses.english: made by a well-known fashion designer and usually expensive
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop sells designer clothes, but she prefers buying fewer items that she can wear for many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家店卖名牌服装，但她更喜欢少买几件能穿多年的衣物。

senses.english: too much pressure on a person or system that can cause problems
senses.exampleEnglish: The unexpected number of visitors put a strain on the small team responsible for serving lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 意外增加的来客数量，给负责午餐服务的小团队带来了压力。

senses.english: a particular type of a plant, microorganism, or similar thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers compared a strain of rice that grows quickly with another that survives better in dry soil.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究人员把生长快的水稻品种与更耐旱的品种比较。

senses.english: to try very hard to see, hear, or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to strain to hear the announcement because the crowd near the entrance was talking loudly.
senses.exampleChinese: 入口附近人群大声交谈，因此我们得竭力才听得见广播。

senses.english: to injure a muscle by using it too forcefully
senses.exampleEnglish: He did not want to strain his back, so he asked someone to help carry the heavy cabinet.
senses.exampleChinese: 他不想拉伤背部，因此请人帮忙搬沉重柜子。

senses.english: to separate liquid from solids by passing it through a fine material
senses.exampleEnglish: You should strain the sauce before serving it if you want to remove the small pieces of onion.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果想去掉洋葱碎块，上桌前应先过滤酱汁。

senses.english: an injury caused by stretching a muscle too far
senses.exampleEnglish: A minor strain kept him out of the match, although he still came along to support the rest of the team.
senses.exampleChinese: 轻微拉伤让他不能参赛，不过仍来支持队友。

senses.english: new invention or idea that is created
senses.exampleEnglish: The award recognises innovation that makes daily life easier without requiring people to buy expensive new equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 该奖项表彰能让日常生活更便利、又不要求人们购买昂贵新设备的创新。

senses.english: book with a collection of photographs or pictures
senses.exampleEnglish: We found an old album containing photographs of the village before the main road was built.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们发现一本老相册，收录了主干道修建前这个村庄的照片。

senses.english: a collection of recorded songs or musical pieces released together
senses.exampleEnglish: The band's new album includes songs they developed while travelling between small towns during their first tour.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐队新专辑包含首次巡演在小镇间旅行时创作的歌曲。

senses.english: a person who sings, often as a profession
senses.exampleEnglish: The singer paused between songs to explain how travelling had influenced the stories behind her latest music.
senses.exampleChinese: 歌手在歌曲间暂停，解释旅行经历如何影响她最新音乐背后的故事。

senses.english: a path through the countryside, often where people walk
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed a marked trail through the forest, stopping occasionally to check our position on the map.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿着有标记的小径穿过森林，偶尔停下来在地图上确认位置。

senses.english: a series of signs showing where someone went or how something happened
senses.exampleEnglish: The investigator followed a trail of receipts that eventually explained how the missing equipment had been purchased.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查者沿着一串收据线索，最终查清丢失设备如何被购入。

senses.english: to move behind someone or drag something behind you
senses.exampleEnglish: The younger walkers began to trail behind after lunch, so the guide slowed down before the path grew steeper.
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭后年幼步行者开始落后，因此导游在路更陡前放慢速度。

senses.english: a device used for catching animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide showed us an old trap and explained how people once used it to catch small animals.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游给我们看了一个旧捕兽器，并解释人们过去如何用它捕捉小动物。

senses.english: to catch someone or something so that escape is difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: A fallen branch could trap smaller animals beneath the fence, so the volunteers moved it carefully aside.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒下的树枝可能把小动物困在围栏下，因此志愿者小心移开了它。

senses.english: a situation that tricks someone into a harmful choice or mistake
senses.exampleEnglish: We should avoid the trap of assuming that the cheapest option will also cost least to maintain.
senses.exampleChinese: 应避免误以为最便宜的方案维护费也最低。

senses.english: not tightly attached or held
senses.exampleEnglish: One of the cupboard handles felt loose, so we tightened the screws before the door became difficult to open.
senses.exampleChinese: 柜子的一个把手有些松，因此我们在开门变得困难之前拧紧了螺丝。

senses.english: not closely controlled, exact, or connected
