senses.exampleEnglish: The club has a loose structure that allows members to suggest activities without waiting for a formal committee meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部结构宽松，让成员不必等正式委员会会议就能提出活动建议。

senses.english: not tied up, held, or kept in a place
senses.exampleEnglish: A loose dog appeared near the playground, so the staff calmly asked everyone to stay behind the gate.
senses.exampleChinese: 一只没拴的狗出现在游乐场附近，因此员工平静地请大家留在门后。

phrases.english: small unfinished matters remaining at the end of a task
phrases.exampleEnglish: We still had several loose ends to deal with before the organiser could send the final schedule to every school.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者把最终日程发给各校前，我们仍有几项未完细节需处理。

phrases.english: having nothing particular to do
phrases.exampleEnglish: If you are at a loose end this afternoon, the library could use some help arranging its new books.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果下午你闲着，图书馆整理新书正需要帮手。

phrases.english: to release someone or something from control
phrases.exampleEnglish: The farmer would not let loose the dogs until the visitors had moved safely behind the gate.
phrases.exampleChinese: 农民等游客安全到门后，才放开狗。

senses.english: extra time allowed to complete something
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher agreed to an extension because several students had been unable to access the materials over the weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师同意延期，因为几名学生周末无法获取学习材料。

senses.english: a new part added to an existing building
senses.exampleEnglish: The extension will give the library room for workshops without reducing the space currently used for quiet study.
senses.exampleChinese: 扩建部分将为图书馆增加工作坊空间，不减少现有安静学习区。

senses.english: a telephone line connected to a main office system
senses.exampleEnglish: Ask for extension twenty when you call, since the general reception team cannot answer detailed questions about deliveries.
senses.exampleChinese: 打电话请转二十分机，因为总接待团队无法回答配送细节。

senses.english: letters at the end of a filename that identify its format
senses.exampleEnglish: Check the file extension before opening the document, because the program may not support every format you receive.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开文档前检查扩展名，因为程序未必支持收到的每一种格式。

senses.english: a small software component that adds functions to a larger program
senses.exampleEnglish: The browser extension can save useful pages, although the school needs to check it before installing it on shared computers.
senses.exampleChinese: 浏览器扩展可保存有用网页，不过学校须检查后再装到共用电脑。

senses.english: large amount of money and possessions
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how the city's wealth grew as merchants developed trade with ports across the sea.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示了商人与海外港口发展贸易时，这座城市的财富如何增长。

senses.english: a large amount or variety of something useful
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide has a wealth of local knowledge that helps visitors find interesting places outside the usual tourist routes.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游有丰富本地知识，帮助游客发现常规旅游路线之外的有趣地点。

senses.english: occurring in a slow manner over a period of time
senses.exampleEnglish: As the morning mist gradually disappeared, we began to see the villages scattered across the valley below.
senses.exampleChinese: 晨雾渐渐散去后，我们开始看见下方山谷中散落的村庄。

senses.english: container for holding liquid or gas
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer installed a large tank to collect rainwater that could be used during the dry summer months.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民安装了一个大水箱收集雨水，以便在干燥的夏季使用。

senses.english: a heavy military vehicle with armour and a large gun
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displays a tank beside photographs that explain how the town experienced the conflict many years ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆展出一辆坦克，旁边照片解释小镇多年前如何经历冲突。

senses.english: to fall sharply in value or fail very badly
senses.exampleEnglish: Sales could tank if the company raises prices before explaining why the new version offers customers better value.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果公司未说明新版价值就涨价，销售额可能骤跌。

senses.english: morally bad; causing harm to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel's evil ruler loses power when ordinary people begin to work together instead of fearing one another.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说中，普通人开始合作而不再互相畏惧后，邪恶的统治者失去了权力。

senses.english: morally bad actions or the force believed to cause them
senses.exampleEnglish: The story explores whether ordinary people can resist evil when powerful figures ask them to ignore their neighbours' suffering.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事探讨当权者要求普通人无视邻居苦难时，他们能否抗拒邪恶。

senses.english: interesting and unexpected, worthy of notice
senses.exampleEnglish: It was remarkable how quickly the group solved the problem once everyone had a chance to share their ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都有机会分享想法后，小组解决问题的速度快得惊人。

senses.english: group of musical notes that make a nice sound
senses.exampleEnglish: I recognized the tune immediately, although I could not remember where I had first heard it played.
senses.exampleChinese: 我立刻认出了这个曲调，尽管想不起第一次是在哪里听到的。

senses.english: to adjust a musical instrument so it produces the correct notes
senses.exampleEnglish: The musician arrived early to tune the piano before the hall became crowded and difficult to work in.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐手提前来给钢琴调音，免得大厅拥挤后难以工作。

senses.english: to adjust equipment or a system so that it works well or receives a signal
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to tune the radio carefully because the signal becomes weak when storms approach the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要仔细调台，因为风暴临近海岸时信号会变弱。

phrases.english: to listen to or watch a broadcast
phrases.exampleEnglish: Many residents plan to tune in tonight because the local station will discuss the future of the old theatre.
phrases.exampleChinese: 许多居民准备今晚收听，因为当地台会讨论旧剧院未来。

phrases.english: at the correct musical pitch or in agreement with someone or something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The singers were finally in tune after the conductor slowed the difficult passage and explained how the voices should blend.
phrases.exampleChinese: 指挥放慢难段并解释声部如何融合后，歌手终于合调。

phrases.english: not at the correct musical pitch or not matching something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The piano sounded out of tune, so the teacher chose another instrument before the students began their performance.
phrases.exampleChinese: 钢琴听着走调，因此老师在学生表演前换了乐器。

senses.english: plants with narrow green leaves, grown on lawns
senses.exampleEnglish: The grass was still wet from overnight rain, so we spread a waterproof sheet before sitting down.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜间下雨后草地还湿着，因此我们先铺好防水垫才坐下。

senses.english: when someone asks you to do something or go somewhere
senses.exampleEnglish: We accepted their invitation to dinner because it would give us a chance to meet the new neighbours.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们接受了他们的晚餐邀请，因为这让我们有机会结识新邻居。

senses.english: a gradual change from one condition to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The school helped children manage the transition to a larger building by arranging visits before the new term began.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校在新学期前安排参观，帮助孩子适应搬到更大校舍的转变。

collocations.english: a transition to a new system

senses.english: to make someone afraid or nervous
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden noise may frighten the younger children, so please explain what will happen before the demonstration starts.
senses.exampleChinese: 突然的声响可能吓到年幼的孩子，所以请在演示开始前说明将会发生什么。

senses.english: to offer a price for something at an auction or in competition with other buyers
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided not to bid for the painting after the auction price rose beyond what we could afford.
senses.exampleChinese: 拍卖价格超出我们的承受能力后，我们决定不再竞价购买那幅画。

senses.english: an offer to pay a price or an attempt to achieve something
senses.exampleEnglish: Their bid was accepted because it offered a reliable service rather than simply promising the lowest possible price.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的投标被接受，因为提供可靠服务，而非只承诺最低价格。

senses.english: to produce baby animals of specific kinds
senses.exampleEnglish: The farm used to breed working horses, although most of its land is now used for growing vegetables.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家农场过去繁育役用马，虽然现在大部分土地用于种植蔬菜。

senses.english: a type of animal developed by breeding for particular features
senses.exampleEnglish: This breed needs plenty of exercise, so the shelter checks whether potential owners have enough time for daily walks.
senses.exampleChinese: 这种狗需要大量运动，因此收容所确认领养者是否有时间每天遛狗。

senses.chinese: 超乎寻常的，特别的，非凡的
senses.english: beyond what is ordinary; very unusual; remarkable
senses.exampleEnglish: The team showed extraordinary patience while helping visitors who needed the same instructions explained several different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队表现出非凡的耐心，帮助那些需要以不同方式重复讲解同一说明的游客。

senses.english: having a great amount of intelligence or talent
senses.exampleEnglish: The brilliant young engineer found a simple solution that more experienced colleagues had overlooked during earlier discussions.
senses.exampleChinese: 那位才华出众的年轻工程师找到了一个简单方案，经验更丰富的同事在此前讨论中都忽略了它。

senses.english: extremely good or enjoyable
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteer had a brilliant idea that let the whole group finish the task without buying extra equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者想出绝妙主意，让大家不买额外设备也能完成任务。

senses.english: extremely bright or strong in colour
senses.exampleEnglish: Brilliant sunlight filled the room after we opened the shutters, revealing colours that had looked dull the evening before.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开百叶窗后，灿烂阳光洒满房间，映出前晚显得暗淡的色彩。

senses.english: an expert who suggests what someone should do
senses.exampleEnglish: The financial adviser explained the possible costs clearly before asking which option best suited the family's circumstances.
senses.exampleChinese: 财务顾问先清楚说明可能的费用，再询问哪种方案最适合这个家庭的情况。

senses.english: the long, thin part of a plant that supports leaves and flowers
senses.exampleEnglish: The plant's stem bent towards the window because that side of the room received more natural light.
senses.exampleChinese: 植物的茎弯向窗户，因为房间那一侧有更多自然光。

senses.english: to develop from or be caused by something, usually followed by from
senses.exampleEnglish: Many of the delays stem from unclear instructions rather than a lack of effort among the volunteers.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多延误源于说明不清，而非志愿者不努力。

phrases.english: to be caused by something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Most misunderstandings stem from unclear instructions rather than a lack of interest among the people who volunteer.
phrases.exampleChinese: 多数误会源于说明不清，而非志愿者缺乏兴趣。

senses.english: to go in the opposite direction
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver had to reverse slowly along the lane because there was not enough space to turn around.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机不得不沿小巷慢慢倒车，因为没有足够空间掉头。

senses.english: going in the opposite direction or having the opposite order
senses.exampleEnglish: The reverse journey took much longer because the afternoon traffic was heavier near the entrance to the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 回程用时长得多，因为下午进城口附近交通更拥堵。

senses.english: the opposite side or the opposite of a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: Write your contact details on the reverse so that the organiser can return the photograph after the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 把联系方式写在背面，组织者便能在展后退还照片。

senses.english: to change a decision, action, or process to its opposite
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee may reverse its decision if new evidence shows that the proposed entrance would be unsafe for visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 若新证据说明拟议入口不安全，委员会可能撤回决定。

phrases.english: in the opposite direction or order
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide showed the process in reverse so that the class could see how the finished model had been assembled.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游反向展示过程，让全班看清成品模型如何组装。

senses.english: way of acting or doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: Switch the camera to automatic mode if you want it to choose the settings while you concentrate on framing.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果你想专注构图，让相机自行选择参数，就切换到自动模式。

senses.english: a thing with a glass surface used to look at yourself
senses.exampleEnglish: The mirror opposite the window made the small room appear brighter by reflecting light towards the darker corner.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗户对面的镜子把光线反射向较暗的角落，让小房间显得更明亮。

senses.english: to reflect something or be very similar to it
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey results mirror what teachers had noticed in class, although they still need to understand why it happens.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查结果与老师课堂观察相符，不过仍需理解发生原因。

senses.english: very bad; horrible; terrible
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather was awful when we arrived, but the warm welcome at the guesthouse quickly improved our mood.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时天气糟透了，但旅馆热情的欢迎很快让我们心情好转。

phrases.english: a very large amount or number
phrases.exampleEnglish: We learned an awful lot from the first trial, even though several parts of the plan needed to change afterwards.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们从首次试验学到很多，尽管之后计划多处要改。

senses.english: to put someone in a position to be photographed
senses.exampleEnglish: The photographer asked the group to pose beside the window, where the natural light was softer and more even.
senses.exampleChinese: 摄影师让大家在窗旁摆好姿势，因为那里的自然光更柔和、更均匀。

senses.english: to cause a problem or present a question
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow entrance may pose a problem when visitors arrive together, so we should arrange a separate exit.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客一起到达时，狭窄入口可能造成问题，因此应另设出口。

senses.english: a position held by the body, especially for a photograph or painting
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist asked her to hold the same pose until the main lines of the portrait were complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家请她保持同一姿势，直到肖像主要线条画完。

senses.english: to change so as to fit in with new conditions
senses.exampleEnglish: You may need to adjust the chair before starting work so that the screen is at a comfortable height.
senses.exampleChinese: 开始工作前，你可能需要调整椅子，让屏幕处于舒适的高度。

senses.english: having the ability to make something new
senses.exampleEnglish: The children found a creative way to reuse old boxes instead of throwing them away after the move.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬家后，孩子们找到了一种有创意的方法利用旧箱子，而不是把它们扔掉。

senses.english: at the present time; now
senses.exampleEnglish: Many travellers nowadays book their own accommodation online, although some still prefer advice from a local travel agent.
senses.exampleChinese: 如今许多旅行者在网上自行预订住宿，不过有些人仍喜欢咨询当地旅行代理。

senses.english: a written composition in verse, not prose
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a poem about the sea because its rhythm reminded her of waves reaching the shore.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选了一首关于大海的诗，因为诗的节奏让她想起海浪涌向岸边。

senses.english: concerning farming
senses.exampleEnglish: The region's agricultural production increased after farmers began sharing equipment and learning more effective ways to manage water.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民开始共用设备并学习更有效的用水方法后，这个地区的农业产量提高了。

senses.english: someone taking part in a race, business, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Each competitor received the same instructions before the race, so nobody would gain an advantage through better information.
senses.exampleChinese: 赛前每位选手都收到相同说明，确保没有人因掌握更多信息而占优势。

senses.english: drinks such as wine, whiskey, beer
senses.exampleEnglish: The café does not serve alcohol, which makes it a popular meeting place for families after school events.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家咖啡馆不供应酒精饮品，因此很受学校活动后聚会的家庭欢迎。

senses.english: cultural event with a program of events
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival brings musicians from different regions together, allowing visitors to hear styles they might never encounter elsewhere.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个节日把各地音乐家聚在一起，让游客听到其他地方可能难以遇到的音乐风格。

senses.english: a plant that is raised and eaten as food
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer explained how each vegetable was grown before inviting the children to choose ingredients for their soup.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民先解释每一种蔬菜是如何种植的，再请孩子们挑选做汤的食材。

senses.english: truck with an enclosed cargo space
senses.exampleEnglish: We hired a van for the move because several pieces of furniture would not fit inside an ordinary car.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们搬家租了一辆货车，因为几件家具装不进普通汽车。

senses.english: feeling that you can do well at something
senses.exampleEnglish: After practising the explanation with a colleague, I felt confident that I could answer the visitors' questions clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 与同事练习讲解后，我有信心能清楚回答游客的问题。

senses.english: one of the bodies that orbit the sun
senses.exampleEnglish: The class designed a model planet and explained how its distance from the sun might affect its climate.
senses.exampleChinese: 全班设计了一颗模型行星，并解释它与太阳的距离可能如何影响气候。

senses.english: a smooth rounded line that is not straight
senses.exampleEnglish: The road follows a gentle curve around the lake, giving passengers a clear view of the mountains beyond.
senses.exampleChinese: 道路沿着湖边缓缓转弯，让乘客能清楚看到远处群山。

senses.english: to bend or move in a smooth rounded line
senses.exampleEnglish: The path begins to curve around the lake just beyond the bridge where we stopped for lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 过了我们午餐停留的桥，小路开始沿湖弯曲。

senses.english: the middle part of your leg that bends
senses.exampleEnglish: She rested her notebook on one knee while listening to the guide explain the history of the castle.
senses.exampleChinese: 她把笔记本放在一侧膝盖上，听导游介绍城堡的历史。

senses.english: to succeed in a struggle
senses.exampleEnglish: The group managed to overcome the language barrier by using drawings, gestures, and a shared willingness to listen.
senses.exampleChinese: 通过绘图、手势和彼此愿意倾听的态度，这个小组成功克服了语言障碍。

senses.english: a net made by spiders; many things connected together
senses.exampleEnglish: A delicate web stretched between the branches, becoming visible when tiny drops of morning dew caught the light.
senses.exampleChinese: 一张精巧的蜘蛛网横在树枝之间，晨露的小水珠反射光线后才显现出来。

senses.english: the system of connected websites that people access using the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum puts its collection on the web so that people can explore it without travelling to the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆把馆藏放上网，让人们不用进城也能探索。

senses.english: a complicated set of connected things or relationships
senses.exampleEnglish: The researcher described a web of connections between businesses that shared equipment and recommended customers to one another.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究者描述了企业之间复杂的联系网络：它们共用设备、互相推荐顾客。

senses.english: distance below a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide checked the depth of the water before allowing anyone to step from the boat onto the shore.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游先检查水深，再允许人们从船上踏向岸边。

senses.english: the amount of detail, understanding, or intensity something has
senses.exampleEnglish: The report explores the problem in depth rather than offering a quick explanation that ignores residents' different experiences.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告深入探讨问题，而非给出忽视居民不同经历的快速解释。

phrases.english: in a situation too difficult for your knowledge or experience
phrases.exampleEnglish: If you feel out of your depth during the training, ask for help before the task becomes more complicated.
phrases.exampleChinese: 培训中若觉得力不从心，要在任务更复杂前求助。

senses.english: a way into a place
senses.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet at the main entrance because it was easier to find than the smaller side door.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们约好在正门见面，因为那里比小侧门更容易找。

senses.english: the act or right of going into a place or joining an institution
senses.exampleEnglish: Entrance to the exhibition is free, but visitors must reserve a place because the small building cannot hold large groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览免费入场，但建筑很小无法容纳大批人，游客必须预约。

senses.english: a piece of a tree that has been cut
senses.exampleEnglish: The children sat on a fallen log while the guide explained how insects helped break down old wood.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们坐在倒下的原木上，听导游解释昆虫如何帮助分解枯木。

senses.english: a written record of events or measurements kept in order
senses.exampleEnglish: We kept a log of the weather so that the class could compare changes over several weeks.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们记录天气日志，让全班比较几周中的变化。

senses.english: to make an official or organised record of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please log every change before testing again so that the next team can understand exactly what you did.
senses.exampleChinese: 再次测试前请记录每项变化，让下一组准确知道你做了什么。

phrases.english: to enter a computer system by identifying yourself
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please log in before opening the shared folder, otherwise the system may not allow you to save your changes.
phrases.exampleChinese: 打开共享文件夹前请登录，否则系统可能不让保存改动。

phrases.english: to leave a computer system securely
phrases.exampleEnglish: Remember to log out after using the library computer so that the next visitor cannot access your account.
phrases.exampleChinese: 用完图书馆电脑记得退出，免得下位访客进入你的账户。

senses.english: extremely big, or much bigger than other things
senses.exampleEnglish: A giant screen allowed people at the back of the hall to see the demonstration more clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 一块巨大的屏幕让大厅后排的人也能更清楚地观看演示。

senses.english: a very large person or an organisation much bigger than others
senses.exampleEnglish: The story follows a friendly giant who helps villagers repair their homes after a storm damages the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事讲述一位友善巨人，在风暴破坏山谷后帮村民修房子。

senses.english: a being with special powers that cannot be explained by nature
senses.exampleEnglish: In the ancient story, a sea god protects the sailors when they show respect for the natural world.
senses.exampleChinese: 在这个古老故事里，水手尊重自然时，一位海神便保护他们。

phrases.english: used to express a strong wish that something bad will not happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: God forbid that the roads should close again before the families have found a safe place to stay tonight.
phrases.exampleChinese: 但愿家人们找到今晚安全住处前，道路别再次封闭。

senses.english: part of a whole
senses.exampleEnglish: We saved a small portion of the budget for unexpected costs that might arise during the repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们预留了一小部分预算，以应对修缮期间可能出现的意外费用。

senses.english: to divide food or something else into suitable amounts
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will portion the rice into smaller containers before families arrive to collect their evening meals.
senses.exampleChinese: 家庭来取晚饭前，志愿者会把米饭分装进小容器。

phrases.english: to divide something into amounts for different people or purposes
phrases.exampleEnglish: We can portion out the supplies once the group knows exactly how many families will arrive at the centre.
phrases.exampleChinese: 知道会有多少家庭到中心后，我们就能分配物资。

senses.english: a particular type of material
senses.exampleEnglish: The laboratory examined a white substance found near the river to discover whether it came from the nearby factory.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验室检查了河边发现的一种白色物质，确定它是否来自附近工厂。

senses.english: the important meaning or real content of something
senses.exampleEnglish: I agreed with the substance of her argument, although I thought some examples needed to be explained more clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我同意她论点的实质，不过觉得部分例子需解释得更清楚。

senses.english: large; full or complete
senses.exampleEnglish: The report contains extensive information about local transport, including routes that are rarely mentioned in tourist guides.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告包含大量当地交通信息，包括旅游指南中很少提及的路线。

senses.english: to repeat what was said in another language
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you interpret for the visitor while I explain how the booking system works and answer her questions?
senses.exampleChinese: 我解释预订系统如何运作并回答她的问题时，你能为这位访客口译吗？

senses.english: to decide or explain what something means
senses.exampleEnglish: People may interpret the same photograph differently because their own experiences influence which details they notice first.
senses.exampleChinese: 人们可能对同一照片有不同解读，因为经历影响首先注意哪些细节。

senses.english: having the freedom to make your own decisions
senses.exampleEnglish: Moving into a shared apartment gave her more independence while still allowing her to split expenses with friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬进合租公寓让她更加独立，同时仍能与朋友分摊费用。

senses.english: white sweet substance used to make foods sweeter
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe uses less sugar than the original version because the ripe fruit already makes the cake quite sweet.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个食谱比原版少放糖，因为成熟的水果已经让蛋糕很甜。

senses.english: concerning the inside part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The inner pocket is useful for keeping tickets safe while leaving the outer pockets free for smaller everyday items.
senses.exampleChinese: 内袋适合安全放置车票，同时让外袋留给日常小物件。

senses.english: relating to personal feelings or thoughts not shown openly
senses.exampleEnglish: The diary reveals her inner doubts, which contrast with the confident manner that her colleagues usually see.
senses.exampleChinese: 日记揭示她内心的疑虑，与同事通常看到的自信举止形成反差。

phrases.english: the small group closest to a leader or important person
phrases.exampleEnglish: The decision came from the director's inner circle, although other staff would be responsible for carrying it out.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定来自主任核心圈，不过要由其他员工落实。

senses.english: to hurt, damage, or cause problems
senses.exampleEnglish: Leaving heavy bags on the narrow stairs could harm someone who needs to pass through in a hurry.
senses.exampleChinese: 把重包放在狭窄楼梯上，可能会伤到需要匆忙经过的人。

senses.english: damage or injury caused to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new path allows visitors to enjoy the wetland without causing harm to the plants growing near the water.
senses.exampleChinese: 新步道让游客欣赏湿地，又不伤害水边植物。

phrases.english: used to say that an action is reasonable and unlikely to cause trouble
phrases.exampleEnglish: There is no harm in asking for another explanation if the first set of instructions still seems unclear.
phrases.exampleChinese: 若第一版说明仍不清楚，再请解释一次也无妨。

senses.english: to discuss something to make a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: We should consult the residents before changing the park, since they understand how the space is actually used.
senses.exampleChinese: 改造公园前，我们应该征求居民意见，因为他们了解这片空间实际如何被使用。

senses.english: to look at a book or other source to get information
senses.exampleEnglish: You should consult the map before leaving the main road, because some smaller paths are not clearly marked.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开主路前应查阅地图，因为有些小路标记不清。

senses.english: pale red color
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose pale pink curtains because they matched the flowers painted on the wall beside the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选了浅粉色窗帘，因为它们与窗边墙上画的花朵相配。

senses.english: a pale red colour
senses.exampleEnglish: She added a little pink to the painting because the sky had looked too cold in the first version.
senses.exampleChinese: 她给画面添了点粉红，因为第一版的天空显得太冷。

senses.english: a dark shape that appears when something stops the light
senses.exampleEnglish: We rested in the shadow of the old tower while waiting for the afternoon heat to become less intense.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在古塔的阴影里休息，等待午后的热度减弱。

senses.english: a feeling of worry or sadness caused by something
senses.exampleEnglish: Uncertainty about the building's future cast a shadow over the celebration, despite everyone's pride in the finished garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管大家为建成的花园自豪，建筑前途未定仍给庆祝蒙上阴影。

senses.english: to follow someone closely, secretly or to learn their work
senses.exampleEnglish: The trainee will shadow an experienced guide before leading a group through the museum without direct supervision.
senses.exampleChinese: 实习生会先跟随有经验导游学习，再独立带队参观博物馆。

senses.english: to take something away from (someone)
senses.exampleEnglish: Before repainting the door, we need to strip the old paint away so that the new coat sticks properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 重新漆门之前，我们需要去掉旧漆，让新漆能牢固附着。

senses.english: a long narrow piece of something
senses.exampleEnglish: A strip of coloured paper marked each chapter, making it easier for the children to find their favourite stories.
senses.exampleChinese: 每章夹一条彩纸，让孩子更容易找到喜欢的故事。

senses.english: to take off clothing or another outer covering
senses.exampleEnglish: The swimmers had to strip off their wet outer layers before changing into warm clothes inside the shelter.
senses.exampleChinese: 游泳者得先脱掉湿外层衣物，再在遮蔽处换暖和衣服。

phrases.english: to take something apart or remove its unnecessary outer parts
phrases.exampleEnglish: The technician will strip down the machine before deciding whether replacing the damaged parts is worth the cost.
phrases.exampleChinese: 技术员先拆开机器，再决定换坏件是否值得。

senses.english: something that feels pleasant and flat when you touch it; not rough
senses.exampleEnglish: The smooth wooden handle was comfortable to hold, even after we had been using the tool for several hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 这工具的光滑木柄握着很舒服，即使连续用了几个小时也是如此。

senses.english: happening without difficulty, interruption, or sudden changes
senses.exampleEnglish: Careful preparation ensured a smooth transition when the class moved from the old building into the new rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 认真准备确保班级从旧楼搬入新教室时平稳顺利。

senses.english: to make a surface flat or even
senses.exampleEnglish: Use the tool to smooth the edges before painting, otherwise the rough parts will remain easy to see.
senses.exampleChinese: 上漆前用工具磨平边缘，否则粗糙处仍很明显。

phrases.english: to make a disagreement or difficulty seem less serious
phrases.exampleEnglish: A brief conversation helped smooth over the disagreement before the team began working together on the next stage.
phrases.exampleChinese: 简短交谈缓和了分歧，让团队能合作下一阶段。

senses.english: involvement in a situation to prevent future problems
senses.exampleEnglish: Early intervention by the manager prevented a small disagreement from becoming a problem that affected the whole team.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理及早介入，避免一场小分歧发展成影响整个团队的问题。

senses.english: to make someone admire or respect another person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The presentation should impress the visitors if we explain the results clearly rather than using unnecessarily complicated language.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果我们清楚解释结果，而不是使用不必要的复杂语言，演示应该能给游客留下好印象。

phrases.english: to make someone understand that something is important
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide tried to impress upon us the importance of staying on the path near the protected nesting area.
phrases.exampleChinese: 导游试图让我们深知在保护鸟巢区附近不离小路的重要。

senses.english: test of your knowledge or ability in something
senses.exampleEnglish: I reviewed my notes with a friend before the exam because explaining ideas aloud helped me notice gaps.
senses.exampleChinese: 考试前我和朋友复习笔记，因为把想法讲出来能帮助我发现知识漏洞。

senses.english: type of evildoing
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel explores greed as a vice that gradually damages the main character's friendships and sense of responsibility.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说把贪婪作为一种恶习来探讨，描写它如何逐渐破坏主人公的友谊和责任感。

senses.english: a tool that holds an object firmly while work is done on it
senses.exampleEnglish: The carpenter secured the wood in a vice before cutting it, so both hands remained free to guide the saw.
senses.exampleChinese: 木匠先用台钳固定木头再切割，让双手能自由控制锯子。

phrases.english: used to say that the opposite order or relationship is also true
phrases.exampleEnglish: Older pupils help younger ones with reading, and vice versa when the younger children explain games they know better.
phrases.exampleChinese: 高年级帮助低年级阅读，而低年级更熟悉的游戏则反过来教。

senses.english: very new and different from what is traditional
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee considered a radical redesign after discovering that small adjustments would not solve the building's main problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会发现小修小改无法解决建筑的主要问题后，考虑了彻底重新设计。

senses.english: supporting major changes in politics or society
senses.exampleEnglish: The group proposed radical reforms, while other members preferred smaller changes that could be tested before wider adoption.
senses.exampleChinese: 该团体提出激进改革，其他成员则偏好可先测试再推广的小变动。

senses.english: a person who supports major political or social change
senses.exampleEnglish: She was considered a radical because she questioned rules that many of her contemporaries accepted without discussion.
senses.exampleChinese: 她被视为激进者，因为质疑了许多同代人不加讨论就接受的规则。

senses.english: in a way that is almost the same as something or someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: The two villages developed similarly because both relied on the same river for transport, farming, and local trade.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两个村庄的发展方式相似，因为都依靠同一条河进行运输、农业和当地贸易。

senses.english: to act in a particular way; to act correctly
senses.exampleEnglish: We explained how visitors should behave around the animals so that everyone could enjoy the farm safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们解释了在动物周围应有的行为，让所有人都能安全游览农场。

senses.english: making a lot of noise
senses.exampleEnglish: The music was so loud that we moved to another table where we could hear each other clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐太响了，我们换到另一张桌子，才能清楚听见彼此说话。

senses.english: in a way that produces a lot of sound
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not speak so loud in the reading room, since other visitors are trying to concentrate.
senses.exampleChinese: 请别在阅览室说得那么大声，其他访客正试图集中注意。

phrases.english: aloud so that others can hear
phrases.exampleEnglish: Reading the paragraph out loud helped me notice a missing word that I had overlooked several times on the screen.
phrases.exampleChinese: 把段落读出声，让我发现屏幕上多次漏看的缺词。

senses.english: measurement of length, width, or height
senses.exampleEnglish: Check each dimension of the shelf before ordering it, since the space beside the window is quite limited.
senses.exampleChinese: 订购架子前核查每个尺寸，因为窗边的空间相当有限。

senses.english: one part or aspect of a subject or situation
senses.exampleEnglish: Talking to local families added another dimension to the research, which had previously focused only on transport costs.
senses.exampleChinese: 与当地家庭交谈，为原先只关注交通费的研究增加了新层面。

senses.english: happening after
senses.exampleEnglish: The first meeting introduced the problem, while subsequent sessions focused on testing possible solutions with local residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次会议介绍了问题，后续会议则着重与当地居民一起测试可能的解决办法。

senses.english: act or state of becoming infected with a disease
senses.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains why cleaning shared equipment matters, using a simple example of how an infection can spread.
senses.exampleChinese: 传单用感染如何传播的简单例子，解释清洁共用设备为何重要。

senses.english: a light, thin coat
senses.exampleEnglish: I brought a light jacket because the forecast suggested that the temperature would fall sharply after sunset.
senses.exampleChinese: 我带了一件薄夹克，因为预报显示日落后气温将明显下降。

senses.english: a removable paper cover protecting a book
senses.exampleEnglish: The book's jacket was damaged, but the pages inside were clean enough for the library to lend it again.
senses.exampleChinese: 书的护封损坏了，但内页够干净，图书馆仍可再借出。

senses.english: working well; producing something without waste
senses.exampleEnglish: Sharing a clear timetable improved efficiency because volunteers no longer had to ask who was responsible for each task.
senses.exampleChinese: 共用明确的时间表提高了效率，因为志愿者不必再询问每项任务由谁负责。

senses.english: not clean
senses.exampleEnglish: The children left their dirty boots near the entrance so that they would not bring mud into the kitchen.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们把脏靴子留在入口附近，以免把泥带进厨房。

senses.english: dishonest or unfair, or morally offensive
senses.exampleEnglish: The captain rejected a dirty trick that might have helped the team win but would have damaged its reputation.
senses.exampleChinese: 队长拒绝了一种可能助赢、却会损害声誉的卑鄙手段。

senses.english: a number that represents a piece of information
senses.exampleEnglish: The article included a statistic about commuting times, but it did not explain how the information had been collected.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章引用了一项通勤时间统计数据，却没有说明信息是如何收集的。

senses.english: the study of collecting and analysing numerical information, used as statistics
senses.exampleEnglish: She studied statistics because she wanted to understand how surveys could support reliable decisions about local services.
senses.exampleChinese: 她学习统计学，因为想理解调查如何支持对地方服务作出可靠决策。

senses.english: at the usual time each day, week, or month
senses.exampleEnglish: We regularly check the emergency lights so that visitors can find their way out if the electricity supply fails.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们定期检查应急灯，让游客在停电时也能找到出口。

senses.english: often, even when not at fixed intervals
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors regularly ask about the old bridge, so we added a short explanation beside the entrance map.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客经常问旧桥，因此我们在入口地图旁加了一段简短说明。

senses.english: a place where people go on holiday
senses.exampleEnglish: The resort offers quiet walking routes as well as crowded beaches, so visitors can choose different kinds of holiday.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个度假区既有安静的步道，也有热闹的海滩，因此游客能选择不同的度假方式。

senses.english: to use a method because other choices are unavailable or unsuccessful
senses.exampleEnglish: We should try repairing the old equipment before we resort to buying replacements that the small club can barely afford.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应先尝试修旧设备，再不得不购买小俱乐部难以负担的替代品。

phrases.english: to use something undesirable because better alternatives are unavailable
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should not resort to cancelling the event until we have checked whether another suitable room is available.
phrases.exampleChinese: 应先查是否还有合适房间，再决定是否不得不取消活动。

senses.english: the hard metal used to make steel (symbol Fe)
senses.exampleEnglish: The old gate was made of iron, which explained why it was much heavier than it looked.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧门是铁制的，这说明它为何比看起来重得多。

senses.english: a heated tool used to remove wrinkles from clothes
senses.exampleEnglish: She borrowed an iron from reception because the shirt had become badly creased inside her small travel bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 她向前台借熨斗，因为衬衫在小旅行包里皱得厉害。

senses.english: to remove wrinkles from clothes with a heated iron
senses.exampleEnglish: I need to iron the tablecloth before the guests arrive, otherwise it will look untidy beneath the plates.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人来前我得熨桌布，否则盘子下的桌布看起来很不整齐。

senses.english: extremely strong, determined, or strict
senses.exampleEnglish: Her iron determination kept the project moving even when several early attempts failed to attract enough volunteers.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使早期几次尝试未招够志愿者，她坚定意志仍推动项目。

phrases.english: to remove small problems or disagreements before something is finished
phrases.exampleEnglish: The final rehearsal should help us iron out small problems before visitors arrive for the opening ceremony.
phrases.exampleChinese: 最后彩排应能帮我们在开幕来宾到达前解决小问题。

senses.english: to send out signals by radio or television
senses.exampleEnglish: The station will broadcast the discussion live so that residents unable to attend can still hear the proposals.
senses.exampleChinese: 电台将直播这场讨论，让无法到场的居民也能听到提议。

senses.english: a radio, television, or online programme sent to an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: The broadcast included local interviews that helped listeners understand why the proposed changes had caused such strong reactions.
senses.exampleChinese: 节目包括当地访谈，帮助听众理解提议变化为何引起强烈反应。

senses.english: all the people who belong to a club or group
senses.exampleEnglish: The club's membership has grown since it began offering activities that appeal to families as well as individual adults.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部开始提供同时吸引家庭和成年个人的活动后，会员人数增加了。

senses.english: the state of belonging to a group, or the money paid to join
senses.exampleEnglish: The membership includes free access to weekend workshops, although some activities require advance booking because space is limited.
senses.exampleChinese: 会员资格包括免费参加周末工作坊，不过有些活动因空间有限需预约。

senses.english: a food made from flour and water and baked in an oven
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought fresh bread from the village bakery before walking down to the river for a picnic with our friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先到村里面包房买新鲜面包，再到河边与朋友野餐。

senses.english: unable to see; with eyes that cannot see
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum provides descriptions that blind visitors can listen to while exploring the exhibits with a guide.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供可收听的讲解，让盲人游客随导游参观展品。

senses.english: unaware of something or unwilling to consider it
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not remain blind to problems that volunteers have repeatedly reported during the busiest parts of the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不能继续无视志愿者反复报告的繁忙时段问题。

senses.english: to prevent someone from seeing temporarily or permanently
senses.exampleEnglish: The bright reflection could blind the driver for a moment, so the organisers moved the shiny sign elsewhere.
senses.exampleChinese: 强烈反光可能让司机暂时看不见，因此组织者移走了闪亮标牌。

collocations.chinese: 用光使某人暂时看不见

senses.english: a window covering that can be raised or adjusted to control light
senses.exampleEnglish: The new blind keeps sunlight off the screen without making the whole room too dark for reading.
senses.exampleChinese: 新窗帘挡住屏幕阳光，又不让整屋暗得难阅读。

phrases.english: to deliberately ignore something wrong
phrases.exampleEnglish: The manager refused to turn a blind eye when staff reported that the emergency exit was regularly blocked.
phrases.exampleChinese: 员工报告紧急出口常被堵后，经理拒绝视而不见。

senses.english: not mixed with anything else
senses.exampleEnglish: The display showed how pure copper differs from mixtures that contain other metals and have different practical uses.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示了纯铜与含有其他金属、具有不同实际用途的混合物有何差别。

senses.english: complete, used to emphasize a quality or cause
senses.exampleEnglish: Finding the missing key was pure luck, since nobody had thought to look beneath the old flowerpot.
senses.exampleChinese: 找到丢失钥匙纯属运气，因为谁也没想到去旧花盆下找。

phrases.english: used to emphasize that one explanation is the whole truth
phrases.exampleEnglish: The decision was about safety, pure and simple, even though some residents believed that cost had played a part.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定纯粹出于安全，尽管部分居民觉得费用也有影响。

senses.english: covered or spotted with blood on the surface
senses.exampleEnglish: In the story, the traveller hides a bloody bandage because he does not want his companions to worry.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事里，旅行者把沾血的绷带藏了起来，因为他不想让同伴担心。

senses.chinese: 该死的；十足的（英式粗俗强调语）
senses.english: an informal British intensifier that can sound rude
senses.exampleEnglish: He called the delay a bloody nuisance, then apologised when he noticed the children standing beside the counter.
senses.exampleChinese: 他骂延误真该死地烦人，看到柜台旁有孩子后又道了歉。

senses.english: someone who supports, helps, or defends you
senses.exampleEnglish: She became a valuable ally when the group needed someone who understood both the technical details and residents' concerns.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组需要兼懂技术细节与居民担忧的人时，她成了一位宝贵的盟友。

senses.english: to join or cooperate with someone for a common purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The smaller clubs decided to ally with the library so that they could share space and attract more visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 小俱乐部决定与图书馆联合，以便共享空间并吸引更多访客。

senses.english: amount or number of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Buy only the quantity of paint you need, since leftover materials can be difficult to store safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 只购买需要的油漆用量，因为剩余材料可能难以安全存放。

senses.english: to make something not straight; make into a curve
senses.exampleEnglish: You can bend the thin wire into a hook, but avoid using force that might cause it to break.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以把细铁丝弯成钩状，但要避免用力过度把它弄断。

senses.english: a curved part of a road, river, or object
senses.exampleEnglish: Slow down before the bend because the tall hedge makes it difficult to see traffic coming from the opposite direction.
senses.exampleChinese: 弯道前请减速，因为高树篱挡住对向来车视线。

phrases.english: to make a very great effort to help or please someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: The staff will bend over backwards to help, but visitors still need to explain clearly what support they require.
phrases.exampleChinese: 员工会尽力帮忙，但访客仍须说清需要什么支持。

senses.english: being an adult, being fully developed physically
senses.exampleEnglish: The garden contains mature trees that provide shade while the younger plants are still developing their roots.
senses.exampleChinese: 花园里有成熟的大树提供树荫，而较小的植物还在生根。

senses.english: to become fully developed or to allow something to develop fully
senses.exampleEnglish: The trees will mature over several years, gradually providing more shade for families who use the playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 树木将在几年内长成熟，逐渐为使用游乐场的家庭提供更多树荫。

senses.english: behaving in a thoughtful and responsible way
senses.exampleEnglish: Her mature response impressed the group because she accepted criticism without blaming the colleagues who had questioned her plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 她不责怪质疑计划的同事而接受批评，成熟回应令人佩服。

senses.english: happening in a short period of time; using few words
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide briefly described the route before giving us maps and asking whether anyone had questions about the walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游简要介绍路线后，给我们发地图，并询问是否有人对步行行程有疑问。

senses.english: for a short time
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped briefly at the village shop before continuing along the path that led towards the old lighthouse.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在村店短暂停留，再沿通往旧灯塔的小路继续走。

senses.english: sound or light used for a warning or to wake someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The alarm sounded just as we were preparing to leave, so everyone followed the marked route outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 警报恰好在我们准备离开时响起，因此大家沿标明的路线走到外面。

senses.english: a sudden strong feeling of worry about possible danger
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden noise caused alarm until the guide explained that workers were moving equipment in the next room.
senses.exampleChinese: 突然的声音令人惊慌，直到导游解释隔壁工人正在搬设备。

senses.english: to make someone worried or frightened
senses.exampleEnglish: The first report may alarm residents, so the council should explain clearly which buildings are actually affected.
senses.exampleChinese: 首份报告可能令居民担忧，因此委员会应清楚说明实际影响哪些楼。

senses.english: to stop someone from working or sleeping
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not disturb the visitors in the quiet room unless there is an urgent message for them.
senses.exampleChinese: 除非有紧急消息要告诉他们，否则请不要打扰安静室内的访客。

senses.english: to make someone worried or upset
senses.exampleEnglish: The photograph may disturb younger visitors, so the guide offers an explanation before the group enters that room.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片可能让年幼访客不安，因此导游在进展厅前先作解释。

senses.english: to maintain, lengthen or continue to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The group needs more volunteers to sustain the weekly programme once the original organisers return to full-time work.
senses.exampleChinese: 最初的组织者恢复全职工作后，这个小组需要更多志愿者维持每周活动。

senses.english: to suffer an injury or damage
senses.exampleEnglish: The building did not sustain serious damage, although the storm broke several windows and loosened part of the roof.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑未遭严重损坏，不过风暴打破几扇窗并弄松部分屋顶。

senses.english: a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry
senses.exampleEnglish: After the flood, neighbours worked together to clean the library and rescue books that could still be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 洪水过后，邻居们合力清理图书馆，抢救仍可使用的书籍。

senses.english: to cover with water or arrive in overwhelming numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: Heavy rain could flood the basement, so staff moved the oldest records to shelves on the upper floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴雨可能淹地下室，因此员工把最老档案移到楼上架子。

senses.english: being poor
senses.exampleEnglish: The project aims to reduce poverty by helping residents develop skills that local employers are actively seeking.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个项目通过帮助居民掌握当地雇主急需的技能，致力于减少贫困。

senses.english: a serious lack of something useful or valuable
senses.exampleEnglish: The reviewer criticised the poverty of ideas in a report that repeated familiar claims without offering practical solutions.
senses.exampleChinese: 评论者批评报告思路贫乏，只重复老说法而不提实用办法。

senses.english: not being sensible or practical
senses.exampleEnglish: Driving across the mountains without checking the weather would be crazy, especially when snow is expected overnight.
senses.exampleChinese: 不查看天气就开车穿越山区很不明智，尤其是预报夜间有雪的时候。

senses.english: very enthusiastic about someone or something, usually followed by about
senses.exampleEnglish: The children are crazy about astronomy, so their teacher arranged a visit to a nearby science centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们痴迷天文，因此老师安排参观附近科学中心。

phrases.english: extremely fond of a person or activity
phrases.exampleEnglish: My sister is crazy about photography, so we planned a route with plenty of places to stop and take pictures.
phrases.exampleChinese: 姐姐痴迷摄影，所以我们规划了很多适合停下拍照的路线。

senses.english: to mention the work of others in your writing
senses.exampleEnglish: Remember to cite the original source whenever you use a quotation or an idea from another writer.
senses.exampleChinese: 每当使用其他作者的引文或观点时，都要记得注明原始来源。

senses.english: very recently; just done or made
senses.exampleEnglish: The newly appointed manager invited everyone to discuss which routines were useful and which needed to change.
senses.exampleChinese: 新上任的经理邀请大家讨论，哪些惯常做法有用，哪些需要改变。

senses.english: very similar and often occurring at the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: The two groups made parallel discoveries, although they had been working independently and had not shared their results.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个小组作出了类似的发现，尽管他们独立工作，未曾交流结果。

senses.english: remaining the same distance apart and never meeting
senses.exampleEnglish: The children drew parallel lines across the paper before using them as guides for their map of the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们先在纸上画平行线，再用来指导绘制村庄地图。

senses.chinese: 相似之处；可相比的事物
senses.english: a similarity or comparable event or situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The historian drew a parallel between the two towns, although their residents had responded differently to industrial change.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史学家指出两镇相似之处，尽管居民对工业变迁反应不同。

senses.english: to be very similar to something or run beside it
senses.exampleEnglish: The new path will parallel the railway until it reaches the bridge near the edge of the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 新步道将与铁路平行，直到通向村边的桥。

phrases.english: at the same time, with separate activities happening alongside each other
phrases.exampleEnglish: The two teams worked in parallel so that one could test the equipment while the other prepared the written instructions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 两队并行工作，一队测试设备，另一队准备书面说明。

senses.english: state of being male or female
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey asked whether a person's gender affected the opportunities they received when applying for different jobs.
senses.exampleChinese: 问卷调查了一个人的性别是否影响其申请不同工作时获得的机会。

senses.english: to help someone or something succeed by giving them money
senses.exampleEnglish: A local business agreed to sponsor the concert, allowing the organisers to keep ticket prices affordable for families.
senses.exampleChinese: 一家当地企业同意赞助音乐会，让组织者能把票价保持在家庭负担得起的水平。

senses.english: a person or organisation that provides money or other support
senses.exampleEnglish: The main sponsor asked for a short report explaining how the equipment would benefit everyone attending the club.
senses.exampleChinese: 主要赞助者要求简要报告，说明设备如何惠及所有俱乐部成员。

senses.english: footwear covering your foot and part of your leg
senses.exampleEnglish: One boot became stuck in the mud as we crossed the field after several days of heavy rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 连续几天大雨后，我们穿过田野时，一只靴子陷在了泥里。

senses.english: the storage space at the back of a car
senses.exampleEnglish: We put the muddy shoes in the boot so that the seats would stay clean during the journey home.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把泥鞋放后备箱，保持回家途中座椅干净。

senses.english: to start a computer so it is ready to use
senses.exampleEnglish: The laptop should boot within a minute, but this older model sometimes needs longer after a software update.
senses.exampleChinese: 笔记本应一分钟内启动，不过这旧型号更新软件后有时更久。

phrases.english: to start a computer and prepare its operating system
phrases.exampleEnglish: The computer may take longer to boot up after the update, so wait before pressing the power button again.
phrases.exampleChinese: 电脑更新后启动可能较慢，请等待而别再次按电源键。

phrases.english: to force someone to leave a place or group
phrases.exampleEnglish: The club would not boot out a member simply for asking difficult questions about how its money was being spent.
phrases.exampleChinese: 俱乐部不会仅因会员追问资金用途，就把他赶走。

senses.english: correct; not having mistakes or errors
senses.exampleEnglish: An accurate map is essential here because several small paths look similar and phone signals are unreliable.
senses.exampleChinese: 这里需要准确的地图，因为几条小路看起来相似，而且手机信号不可靠。

senses.english: someone who buys things to sell to others
senses.exampleEnglish: The dealer explained the history of the old table before showing us how to recognize its original wooden joints.
senses.exampleChinese: 经销商先介绍了旧桌子的历史，再教我们辨认它原来的木质连接结构。

senses.english: a person who gives cards to players in a card game
senses.exampleEnglish: The dealer explained the rules again because two players had never taken part in that particular card game.
senses.exampleChinese: 有两人从没玩过这种纸牌，因此发牌者再次解释规则。

senses.english: small round piece of material used to fasten clothing
senses.exampleEnglish: A button fell off my coat while I was lifting the suitcase onto the overhead luggage rack.
senses.exampleChinese: 我把行李箱举到头顶行李架上时，外套掉了一颗纽扣。

senses.english: a small control pressed to make a machine or program do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Press the green button once the form is complete, and wait until the screen confirms that your details were saved.
senses.exampleChinese: 填完表后按绿色按钮，等屏幕确认资料已保存。

senses.english: to close clothing by fastening its buttons
senses.exampleEnglish: You may need to button your coat before leaving, since the wind becomes much stronger near the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 出门前可能要扣上外套，因为河边风会强很多。

senses.english: to give someone a heavy responsibility or something difficult to deal with
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not burden new volunteers with too many tasks before they understand how the programme works.
senses.exampleChinese: 新志愿者还不清楚项目如何运作时，我们不应该让他们承担太多任务。

senses.english: something difficult or worrying that someone must deal with
senses.exampleEnglish: The extra paperwork became a burden for volunteers who already spent their evenings helping families at the centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 额外文书成了志愿者的负担，他们晚上已在中心帮助家庭。

senses.english: area of land that has very little water and few plants
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary explains how plants survive in the desert despite having very little water for much of the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片解释了植物如何在沙漠生存，尽管一年大部分时间都缺少水。

senses.english: to leave someone or something when support or loyalty is expected
senses.exampleEnglish: The captain refused to desert the passengers, even when the rising water made it difficult to reach them.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使涨水让接近乘客很困难，船长仍拒绝抛弃他们。

senses.english: someone who you work, live, or go to school with
senses.exampleEnglish: My school mate offered to share his notes after I missed the lesson because my train was delayed.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车延误让我错过课程后，我的同学愿意与我分享笔记。

senses.english: the partner of an animal for breeding
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how the bird attracts a mate by making a display with its brightly coloured feathers.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释这种鸟怎样展示鲜艳羽毛吸引配偶。

senses.english: to breed by producing offspring with a partner
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary explains when the birds mate and why the protected wetland is important during that season.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片解释鸟何时交配，以及那时受保护湿地为何重要。

senses.english: not very often; sometimes; seldom
senses.exampleEnglish: We occasionally take the longer route home because it gives us a chance to walk beside the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们偶尔绕远路回家，因为这样有机会沿着河边散步。

senses.english: someone who owns a part of a corporation
senses.exampleEnglish: Each shareholder received a report explaining how the company had used its profits during the previous year.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位股东都收到了一份报告，说明公司在过去一年如何使用利润。

senses.english: a round container used for holding things like rice or soup
senses.exampleEnglish: She placed a bowl of fresh fruit on the table so that guests could help themselves after lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 她把一碗新鲜水果放在桌上，让客人午饭后可以自己取食。

senses.english: to send a ball towards a target in cricket or bowling
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach showed everyone how to bowl before splitting the class into small teams for a friendly game.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练先示范怎样投球，再把全班分小队进行友谊赛。

phrases.english: to surprise or impress someone very strongly
phrases.exampleEnglish: Their unexpected kindness will bowl over the visitors, who thought they would have to arrange everything without local help.
phrases.exampleChinese: 意外的善意会让游客惊喜，他们原以为没当地帮助得事事自行安排。

senses.english: learning something for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: The discovery of an old photograph helped us identify the people who had lived in the house before us.
senses.exampleChinese: 一张老照片的发现，帮助我们认出了曾在我们之前住在这栋房子里的人。

senses.english: refusal to accept something new or different
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal faced resistance from residents who worried that the new road would make their neighbourhood noisier.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案遭到居民反对，他们担心新道路会让社区更加吵闹。

senses.english: a force or property that opposes movement or electric current
senses.exampleEnglish: The class compared air resistance using paper shapes that fell at different speeds from the same height.
senses.exampleChinese: 全班用从同一高度以不同速度落下的纸形比较空气阻力。

senses.english: the ability to avoid being harmed or affected by something
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson compared the plants' resistance to disease without suggesting that any single variety could survive every condition.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程比较植物抗病性，但没说任一品种都能适应所有条件。

senses.english: the cleaning of a body by putting it completely into water
senses.exampleEnglish: After a long walk in the rain, she enjoyed a warm bath before joining everyone downstairs for dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 在雨中长途步行后，她先洗了个温水澡，再下楼与大家吃晚饭。

senses.english: a large container filled with water for washing the body
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel room had a bath as well as a shower, which pleased the family after their long journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店房间有浴缸也有淋浴，让长途旅行后的全家很高兴。

senses.english: to wash someone in a bath, mainly in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: The parents take turns to bath the baby before reading a story and settling her down for the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 父母轮流给婴儿洗澡，再读故事哄她晚上安睡。

senses.english: how often something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The frequency of buses increased after residents explained how difficult it was to reach work without a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民说明不开车上班有多困难后，公交车的班次增加了。

senses.english: the number of times a wave repeats in a given time
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher changed the frequency of the sound so that students could hear how its pitch became higher.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师改变声音频率，让学生听出音高如何变高。

senses.english: to say that someone or something is bad
senses.exampleEnglish: It is easy to criticize a plan before hearing why the team rejected the other available options.
senses.exampleChinese: 还没听团队解释为何否决其他可用选项，就很容易批评一项计划。

senses.english: to hit something lightly
senses.exampleEnglish: Please tap the screen gently to choose your language before entering the details requested on the next page.
senses.exampleChinese: 请轻触屏幕选择语言，再输入下一页要求的信息。

senses.english: a device controlling the flow of water from a pipe
senses.exampleEnglish: Please turn off the tap after filling the bottle so that water does not continue running into the empty sink.
senses.exampleChinese: 装满瓶后请关龙头，免得水继续流入空水槽。

senses.english: to obtain or use resources from a particular source
senses.exampleEnglish: The project hopes to tap local knowledge by asking older residents how the village managed water before modern pumps.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目请老居民介绍现代水泵出现前村里如何用水，以利用当地知识。

senses.english: a gentle hit with a finger or another small object
senses.exampleEnglish: A light tap on my shoulder made me turn around just as the guide began explaining the next exhibit.
senses.exampleChinese: 肩上轻轻一拍让我转身，恰好导游开始讲下件展品。

phrases.english: to gain access to and use a resource or ability
phrases.exampleEnglish: The project hopes to tap into the skills of retired residents who still enjoy teaching others how to make things.
phrases.exampleChinese: 项目希望利用退休居民的技能，他们仍喜欢教别人制作物件。

senses.english: study of ideas about the fundamental nature of life
senses.exampleEnglish: Studying philosophy encouraged her to question assumptions that she had accepted without much thought during her school years.
senses.exampleChinese: 学习哲学让她开始质疑学生时代未多加思考就接受的假设。

senses.english: a set of beliefs that guides how someone acts
senses.exampleEnglish: Her teaching philosophy gives students time to explore their own questions before she explains the formal rules.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的教学理念是先让学生探索问题，再解释正式规则。

senses.english: top and bottom part of the outside of a person's mouth
senses.exampleEnglish: She bit her lip as she waited for the results, trying not to interrupt the conversation beside her.
senses.exampleChinese: 等待结果时，她咬着嘴唇，尽量不打断身边的谈话。

phrases.english: to remain brave and avoid showing distress, especially in British usage
phrases.exampleEnglish: He tried to keep a stiff upper lip while explaining the setback, although the disappointment was clear to his closest friends.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他解释挫折时努力坚忍，尽管挚友看得出失望。

senses.english: a quality or characteristic that someone or something has (e.g., size or color)
senses.exampleEnglish: Patience is an important attribute for a guide who needs to answer the same questions several times a day.
senses.exampleChinese: 对每天需要多次回答同样问题的导游而言，耐心是一项重要品质。

senses.english: to believe that something was caused by or belongs to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot attribute the improvement to one change, since several parts of the programme were updated together.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不能把改进归于单一变化，因为项目多个部分同时更新了。

senses.english: to say sorry because of a mistake or injury you made
senses.exampleEnglish: I called to apologize for the delay and explained when the replacement package would finally reach their address.
senses.exampleChinese: 我打电话为延误道歉，并说明替换包裹最终何时能送到他们的地址。

senses.english: positive opinion of something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot begin the repairs without the owner's approval, even though the volunteers are ready to start.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使志愿者已准备开工，没有业主的认可，我们也不能开始修缮。

senses.english: official permission for something to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The project needs council approval before volunteers can begin turning the empty building into a community kitchen.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目需委员会批准，志愿者才能把空楼改成社区厨房。

senses.english: to quickly reach out and take something in your hand.
senses.exampleEnglish: She managed to grab her hat before the wind carried it over the wall into the neighbour's garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 她及时抓住帽子，才没让风把它吹过墙，落进邻居的花园。

senses.english: to attract attention strongly or take an opportunity quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: The unusual photograph will grab the audience's attention before the speaker begins explaining the background to the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 不寻常的照片会先吸引观众，再由演讲者解释项目背景。

phrases.english: to have a quick informal meal
phrases.exampleEnglish: We can grab a bite near the station before collecting our bags and catching the last train home.
phrases.exampleChinese: 取包、赶末班火车回家前，我们可在站边快速吃点。

senses.english: to give the right to do or have something to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: These tickets entitle visitors to enter both museums, provided that the second visit takes place within a week.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些票允许游客进入两家博物馆，前提是第二次参观在一周内完成。

senses.english: to give a title to a book, article, or other work
senses.exampleEnglish: The author decided to entitle the chapter New Beginnings because it described the family's arrival in another country.
senses.exampleChinese: 作者决定把这一章题为《新的开始》，因为写的是一家人初到异国。

senses.english: to give to someone for a while before it is returned
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you lend me your spare charger until tomorrow, when the replacement I ordered is expected to arrive?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能把备用充电器借我用到明天吗？我订的替换充电器预计明天到。

senses.english: to give a quality or support to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The old wooden furniture will lend warmth to the room without making the small space feel crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧木家具会给房间增添温暖，又不让小空间显拥挤。

phrases.english: to help someone with a task
phrases.exampleEnglish: Could you lend a hand with the chairs before the first group arrives and the entrance becomes crowded?
phrases.exampleChinese: 首组到、入口拥挤前，你能帮搬椅子吗？

phrases.english: to listen sympathetically to someone's concerns
phrases.exampleEnglish: Sometimes it is better to lend an ear than to offer immediate advice when a colleague describes a difficult experience.
phrases.exampleChinese: 同事描述困难经历时，有时倾听比立即建议更好。

senses.english: act or process of joining in a particular activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Parents' involvement in the project helped teachers understand which activities children most enjoyed discussing at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 家长参与项目，让老师了解孩子在家最喜欢讨论哪些活动。

senses.english: state of experiencing something directly
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular exposure to different accents helped the students understand speakers they had previously found difficult to follow.
senses.exampleChinese: 经常接触不同口音，帮助学生听懂了先前觉得难以跟上的说话者。

senses.english: contact with a potentially harmful substance or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how to reduce exposure to strong sunlight before leading the group across the open plain.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游先解释如何减少强烈日晒，再带队穿过开阔平原。

senses.english: public attention or the act of revealing something hidden
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition gave the young artists exposure beyond their own school, leading to invitations from several local galleries.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览使年轻艺术家在校外得到关注，进而收到当地几家画廊邀请。

senses.english: the amount of light allowed to reach a camera's sensor or film
senses.exampleEnglish: The photographer adjusted the exposure because the bright sky made the people in the foreground appear too dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 摄影师调了曝光，因为明亮天空使前景人物显得太暗。

senses.english: the act of making hidden wrongdoing or facts known publicly
senses.exampleEnglish: The exposure of false claims led the charity to explain more carefully how it checked the information in its reports.
senses.exampleChinese: 虚假说法被揭露后，慈善组织更仔细解释如何核查报告信息。

senses.english: following the common attitudes and practices
senses.exampleEnglish: They chose a conventional design for the bridge because local builders already had experience working with those materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们给桥选了传统设计，因为当地建筑工已有使用这些材料的经验。

senses.english: describing weapons or military methods that do not use nuclear technology
senses.exampleEnglish: The article distinguishes conventional weapons from nuclear weapons before discussing the different agreements that aim to limit their use.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章先区分常规武器与核武器，再讨论限制使用的不同协议。

senses.english: using electronic signals or computers
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum keeps digital copies of old documents so that researchers can study them without handling the fragile originals.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆保存旧文献的数字副本，让研究人员不必触碰脆弱原件就能研究。

senses.english: to change words from one language into another
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you translate the short notice into Chinese so that all the parents understand the change of venue?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能把这份简短通知译成中文，让所有家长都知道地点变更吗？

senses.english: to change an idea, quality, or amount into a practical result
senses.exampleEnglish: A good idea will not automatically translate into a useful service unless the team tests how people actually use it.
senses.exampleChinese: 好想法不会自动变成好服务，团队还须测试人们实际怎样使用。

senses.english: to check and makes changes before publication
senses.exampleEnglish: I usually edit my writing the next morning because a short break makes mistakes easier to notice.
senses.exampleChinese: 我通常第二天早上修改文章，因为稍作间隔后更容易发现错误。

senses.english: a change made to content or a particular edited version
senses.exampleEnglish: The final edit removed several repeated explanations so that readers could follow the argument without losing important details.
senses.exampleChinese: 最终编辑去掉几段重复说明，让读者不丢要点就能跟上论证。

senses.english: process of creating, or making into a particular shape
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explains how the formation of clouds depends on changes in air temperature and water vapour.
senses.exampleChinese: 这节课解释了云的形成如何取决于气温和水蒸气的变化。

senses.english: a group arranged in a particular shape
senses.exampleEnglish: The dancers kept their formation while moving across the stage, even though the music changed speed several times.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管音乐多次变速，舞者在舞台移动时仍保持队形。

senses.english: an initial payment that reserves a purchase or acts as security
senses.exampleEnglish: We paid a small deposit to reserve the room, with the remaining amount due when we arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们付了一小笔订金预留房间，剩余款项在到达时支付。

senses.english: material that has collected slowly on a surface or in a place
senses.exampleEnglish: A mineral deposit had formed inside the pipe, reducing the amount of water that could flow through it.
senses.exampleChinese: 管内形成了一层矿物沉积，减少了能流过的水量。

senses.english: to put something in a place or pay money into an account
senses.exampleEnglish: You can deposit the payment directly into the account, but remember to include the reference shown on the invoice.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以直接把款项存入账户，但记得注明发票上的参考号。

senses.english: money put into a bank account
senses.exampleEnglish: The bank statement showed a deposit that she did not recognise, so she contacted the office to check its source.
senses.exampleChinese: 银行对账单有笔她不认识的存入款，因此她联系办公室查来源。

senses.english: causing a good feeling
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey was surprisingly pleasant because the train was quiet and we had plenty of space for our bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 这段旅程出乎意料地愉快，因为列车安静，行李也有足够地方放。

senses.english: in or to a foreign country that is across a sea
senses.exampleEnglish: She worked overseas for several years before returning home to help her family run their small business.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在海外工作了几年，之后回家帮助家人经营小生意。

senses.english: in or relating to foreign countries across the sea
senses.exampleEnglish: The company invited overseas visitors to see how the local workshop produced furniture using materials from nearby forests.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司邀请海外访客参观当地工坊如何用附近森林材料制作家具。

senses.english: to publicly support a belief, or to request a change
senses.exampleEnglish: The group continues to advocate better public transport because many residents cannot afford to drive to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个团体持续倡导改善公共交通，因为许多居民负担不起开车上班的费用。

senses.english: a person who publicly supports an idea or course of action
senses.exampleEnglish: She became an advocate for safer streets after seeing how difficult the school journey was for younger children.
senses.exampleChinese: 看到年幼儿童上学路艰难后，她成了安全街道的倡导者。

senses.english: organization, institution, or place to do business
senses.exampleEnglish: The family runs a small establishment where travellers can enjoy homemade food and stay in simple, comfortable rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人经营一家小旅店，旅客能享用家常饭菜，住进简单舒适的房间。

senses.english: the act of creating an organisation or system
senses.exampleEnglish: The establishment of a weekly market gave local farmers a place to sell produce without travelling to the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 每周市场的设立，让本地农民无需进城就有地方卖农产品。

senses.english: the influential people and institutions that traditionally hold power
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer challenged the establishment by asking why important decisions were made without listening to ordinary residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 作家质疑当权者，为何重大决策不听普通居民意见。

senses.english: a brief statement that gives the most important information
senses.exampleEnglish: Please include a short summary at the beginning so that busy readers can understand the report's main findings quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在开头加入简短概要，让忙碌的读者迅速了解报告的主要发现。

senses.english: giving the main points without detail
senses.exampleEnglish: The report provides a summary account before presenting the detailed evidence that supports each of its conclusions.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告先作概述，再呈现支持每项结论的详细证据。

senses.english: not smooth, gentle, or careful
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden surface was still rough, so we decided to smooth it before applying the final coat of paint.
senses.exampleChinese: 木头表面仍很粗糙，因此我们决定先把它磨平再刷最后一层漆。

senses.english: not exact or finished in detail
senses.exampleEnglish: We made a rough estimate of the cost before asking suppliers to provide prices for the actual materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先粗估成本，再请供应商报实际材料价格。

senses.english: difficult, unpleasant, or involving strong uneven movement
senses.exampleEnglish: The ferry journey was rough because strong winds had created large waves near the entrance to the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 渡轮航程颠簸，因为强风在港口入口附近掀起大浪。

senses.english: not gentle or careful when handling someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide stopped the rough play before anyone was hurt and suggested a game that needed less physical contact.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游在有人受伤前制止粗暴打闹，改建议身体接触少的游戏。

phrases.english: not polished or exact but good enough for an immediate purpose
phrases.exampleEnglish: Our first model was rough and ready, but it helped the residents understand the idea before we developed it further.
phrases.exampleChinese: 初模型粗糙但可用，帮助居民在深入开发前理解构想。

phrases.english: to live temporarily without normal comforts
phrases.exampleEnglish: We were prepared to rough it for a weekend, but the campsite turned out to have surprisingly comfortable facilities.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们准备周末将就住，但营地设施意外舒适。

senses.english: something you write with that uses ink
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep a pen in your bag in case you need to complete a paper form during the journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 包里放一支笔，以防旅途中需要填写纸质表格。

senses.english: a small enclosed area where animals are kept
senses.exampleEnglish: The lamb stayed in a small pen while the farmer repaired the fence around the larger field.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民修大田围栏时，小羊待在小圈栏里。

senses.english: process of returning to a former state after problems
senses.exampleEnglish: The town's recovery took several years, although neighbours began reopening shops soon after the damaged roads were repaired.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个镇花了几年才恢复，尽管受损道路修复不久，邻居们就开始重新开店。

senses.english: to make something so that it does not leak air or water
senses.exampleEnglish: Please seal the container carefully so that the soup cannot leak while you carry it to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把容器仔细密封，让你带汤去上班的途中不会漏出来。

senses.english: a sea mammal with flippers that spends time in water and on land
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched a seal resting on the rocks while the guide reminded everyone to keep a respectful distance.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看海豹在岩石上休息，导游提醒大家保持距离。

senses.english: a device, strip, or material that closes something securely
senses.exampleEnglish: The broken seal suggested that the container had been opened before it reached the museum's storage room.
senses.exampleChinese: 破封条表明容器到达博物馆库房前曾被打开。

senses.english: an official mark showing approval or authenticity
senses.exampleEnglish: The document carried the town's seal, which helped the historian establish where the original agreement had been signed.
senses.exampleChinese: 文件有市镇印章，帮助历史学家确定原协议在哪签署。

phrases.english: a clear sign that someone accepts or supports something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The successful trial gave the design a seal of approval before the committee agreed to order more copies.
phrases.exampleChinese: 试验成功使设计获得认可，委员会随后同意多订几套。

senses.english: long, hollow object
senses.exampleEnglish: The water flows through a narrow tube before entering the transparent tank where students can observe the process.
senses.exampleChinese: 水先流经一根细管，再进入透明水箱，让学生观察这一过程。

senses.english: a soft container squeezed to release something such as toothpaste
senses.exampleEnglish: I packed a small tube of toothpaste because the larger one would take too much space in my bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 我带小管牙膏，因为大管会太占包的空间。

senses.english: the underground railway system in London
senses.exampleEnglish: We took the Tube to the museum because road traffic was likely to make the bus journey much slower.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们坐伦敦地铁去博物馆，因为道路拥堵可能让公交慢很多。

senses.english: a tall, narrow building
senses.exampleEnglish: From the old tower, visitors can see how the river divides the historic centre from the newer neighbourhoods.
senses.exampleChinese: 从古塔上，游客能看到河流如何把历史城区与较新的社区分开。

senses.english: to be much taller or higher than something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The old trees tower above the houses, providing shade for people walking along the narrow village street.
senses.exampleChinese: 老树高出房屋，为村中窄街上的行人遮阴。

senses.english: to describe the qualities of a person, place, thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The article tries to characterize the town's changing identity through interviews with people who have lived there for decades.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章尝试通过采访在那里居住数十年的人，描绘城镇不断变化的特色。

senses.english: to be a typical or noticeable feature of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Narrow streets characterize the old town, which is why most deliveries must arrive before the shops become busy.
senses.exampleChinese: 狭窄街道是老城特征，因此多数送货要赶在商店繁忙前。

senses.english: to state, name, or mention exactly and clearly
senses.exampleEnglish: Please specify which entrance your group will use so that we can arrange someone to welcome you.
senses.exampleChinese: 请具体说明你们一行使用哪个入口，让我们安排人员迎接。

senses.english: completely correct; accurate; specific
senses.exampleEnglish: I cannot remember the exact date, but the photograph was taken shortly before we moved into the house.
senses.exampleChinese: 我记不起确切日期，不过照片是在我们搬进这栋房子不久前拍的。

senses.english: to demand and obtain something, often payment or revenge
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel asks whether a ruler can exact loyalty from people whose concerns he has repeatedly ignored.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说探讨统治者能否强求那些顾虑一再被忽视的人效忠。

phrases.english: to punish someone in return for an earlier wrong
phrases.exampleEnglish: The novel's hero refuses to exact revenge because he realises that doing so would repeat the harm he wants to stop.
phrases.exampleChinese: 主人公拒绝复仇，因为发现这样会重演他想制止的伤害。

senses.english: to turn around repeatedly
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched the colourful wheel spin while trying to predict which number would appear at the top.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着彩色轮盘转动，试着预测哪个数字会出现在顶部。

senses.english: a short journey in a vehicle, or an act of turning quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: We took the repaired bicycle for a spin before returning it to the owner who had lent it to us.
senses.exampleChinese: 归还借来的自行车前，我们先骑着修好的车兜了一圈。

senses.english: a presentation of information intended to influence how people understand it
senses.exampleEnglish: The reporter questioned the positive spin on the figures because several important costs had not been included.
senses.exampleChinese: 记者质疑数字的正面包装，因为未计入几项重要成本。

collocations.english: put a positive spin on something

senses.english: to describe information in a way intended to influence opinion
senses.exampleEnglish: The spokesperson tried to spin the delay as an advantage, but customers still wanted to know when delivery would happen.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言人试把延迟说成优势，但顾客仍想知道何时交货。

phrases.english: to try a machine, activity, or method informally
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should give it a spin before buying the new tool, since the handle may not suit everyone in the group.
phrases.exampleChinese: 买新工具前应试用，因为把手未必适合全组。

senses.english: someone who uses and controls something, usually equipment
senses.exampleEnglish: The operator stopped the machine after noticing an unusual sound that had not occurred during the earlier tests.
